+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class AFDGraphCaptureVariant:
+    attn_batch_size: int
+    attn_wire_capacity: int
+    child_wire_capacities: tuple[int, ...]
+    child_compute_capacities: tuple[int | None, ...]
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class AFDGraphCapturePlan:
+    # Kept in the attn runner's descending capture order. Different parent
+    # buckets may intentionally share the same child shape tuple.
+    attn_graph_variants: tuple[AFDGraphCaptureVariant, ...]
+    ffn_graph_variants: tuple[tuple[int, int], ...]
+
+    @property
+    def enabled(self) -> bool:
+        return bool(self.attn_graph_variants or self.ffn_graph_variants)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class AFDFFNCapacityPlan:
+    graph_token_buckets: tuple[int, ...]
+    deepep_dispatch_limit: int | None
+
+
+def _select_ffn_graph_capacity(
+    ffn_buckets: list[int],
+    wire_capacity: int,
+    disable_padding: bool,
+) -> int | None:
+    index = bisect.bisect_left(ffn_buckets, wire_capacity)
+    if index == len(ffn_buckets):
+        return None
+    compute_capacity = ffn_buckets[index]
+    if disable_padding and compute_capacity != wire_capacity:
+        return None
+    return compute_capacity
+
+
+def _build_attn_graph_shapes(
+    attn: AFDHandshakeInfo,
+) -> tuple[tuple[int, int, tuple[int, ...]], ...]:
+    attn_graph_capacities = tuple(
+        sorted(set(attn.decode_graph_token_buckets), reverse=True)
+    )
+    transport_buckets = sorted(set(attn.decode_token_buckets))
+    transport_capacities = tuple(reversed(transport_buckets))
+    if not set(attn_graph_capacities).issubset(transport_capacities):
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "AFD attn graph capacities must be transport capacities: "
+            f"graph={attn_graph_capacities}, "
+            f"transport={transport_capacities}"
+        )
+
+    wire_token_multiplier = _attn_wire_tokens_per_bs(attn)
+    shapes = []
+    for attn_wire_capacity in attn_graph_capacities:
+        if attn_wire_capacity % wire_token_multiplier != 0:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "AFD attn graph capacity is not divisible by the fixed wire "
+                "rows per request: "
+                f"capacity={attn_wire_capacity}, "
+                f"rows_per_request={wire_token_multiplier}"
+            )
+        attn_batch_size = attn_wire_capacity // wire_token_multiplier
+        num_microbatches = attn.decode_num_microbatches
+        if num_microbatches > 1 and attn_batch_size >= num_microbatches:
+            child_batch_sizes = split_afd_batch_size(attn_batch_size, num_microbatches)
+            child_wire_capacities = tuple(
+                transport_buckets[
+                    bisect.bisect_left(
+                        transport_buckets,
+                        child_batch_size * wire_token_multiplier,
+                    )
+                ]
+                for child_batch_size in child_batch_sizes
+            )
+        else:
+            child_wire_capacities = (attn_wire_capacity,)
+        shapes.append((attn_batch_size, attn_wire_capacity, child_wire_capacities))
+    return tuple(shapes)
+
+
+def build_afd_ffn_capacity_plan(
+    ffn: AFDHandshakeInfo,
+    attn_members: Sequence[AFDHandshakeInfo],
+    use_deepep_low_latency: bool,
+) -> AFDFFNCapacityPlan:
+    """Derive staged F graph and DeepEP capacities from A admission limits."""
+    graph_enabled = bool(ffn.decode_graph_token_buckets)
+    scattered = ffn.afd_ffn_moe_backend == "deepep"
+    graph_capacities: set[int] = set()
+    graph_capacities_by_session: list[set[int]] = []
+    graph_maxima: list[int] = []
+    dispatch_maxima: list[int] = []
+
+    for attn in attn_members:
+        fan_in = (
+            (attn.num_ranks + ffn.num_ranks - 1) // ffn.num_ranks if scattered else 1
+        )
+        session_graph_capacities = {
+            child_wire_capacity * fan_in
+            for _, _, child_wire_capacities in _build_attn_graph_shapes(attn)
+            for child_wire_capacity in child_wire_capacities
+        }
+        graph_capacities.update(session_graph_capacities)
+        graph_capacities_by_session.append(session_graph_capacities)
+        graph_maxima.append(max(session_graph_capacities, default=0))
+        if scattered and use_deepep_low_latency and attn.decode_token_buckets:
+            dispatch_maxima.append(max(attn.decode_token_buckets) * fan_in)
+
+    graph_max_capacity = sum(graph_maxima)
+    deepep_dispatch_limit = None
+    if scattered and dispatch_maxima:
+        max_single_session = max(dispatch_maxima)
+        if max_single_session > 1024:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "AFD SCATTERED requires at most 1024 DeepEP dispatch tokens "
+                "per rank for one attn session; "
+                f"required={max_single_session}"
+            )
+        deepep_dispatch_limit = min(sum(dispatch_maxima), 1024)
+        # Preserve native DeepEP's default capacity for small admission limits;
+        # shrinking its expert buffers can produce incorrect masked-GEMM results.
+        deepep_dispatch_limit = max(
+            deepep_dispatch_limit,
+            envs.SGLANG_DEEPEP_NUM_MAX_DISPATCH_TOKENS_PER_RANK.default,
+        )
+        graph_max_capacity = min(graph_max_capacity, deepep_dispatch_limit)
+        graph_capacities = {
+            capacity
+            for capacity in graph_capacities
+            if capacity <= deepep_dispatch_limit
+        }
+
+    if not graph_enabled or not graph_max_capacity:
+        graph_buckets: tuple[int, ...] = ()
+    elif ffn.disable_cuda_graph_padding:
+        exact_capacities = {0}
+        for session_capacities in graph_capacities_by_session:
+            exact_capacities |= {
+                base + capacity
+                for base in tuple(exact_capacities)
+                for capacity in session_capacities
+                if base + capacity <= graph_max_capacity
+            }
+        graph_buckets = tuple(
+            sorted(
+                capacity
+                for capacity in exact_capacities
+                if 0 < capacity <= graph_max_capacity
+            )
+        )
+    else:
+        graph_buckets = tuple(
+            build_decode_token_buckets(
+                local_batch_sizes=sorted(graph_capacities),
+                max_local_requests=graph_max_capacity,
+                wire_token_multiplier=1,
+            )
+        )
+
+    return AFDFFNCapacityPlan(
+        graph_token_buckets=graph_buckets,
+        deepep_dispatch_limit=deepep_dispatch_limit,
+    )
+
+
+def _attn_wire_tokens_per_bs(attn: AFDHandshakeInfo) -> int:
+    num_tokens_per_bs = attn.decode_num_tokens_per_bs
+    if not isinstance(num_tokens_per_bs, int) or num_tokens_per_bs <= 0:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "AFD decode_num_tokens_per_bs must be a positive integer; "
+            f"got {num_tokens_per_bs!r}"
+        )
+    rank_multiplier = 1 if attn.afd_ffn_moe_backend == "deepep" else attn.num_ranks
+    return num_tokens_per_bs * rank_multiplier
+
+
+def build_afd_attn_local_graph_variants(
+    handshake: AFDHandshakeResult,
+) -> tuple[AFDGraphCaptureVariant, ...]:
+    if not handshake.requires_eager_decode_communication:
+        return ()
+    attn = handshake.local if handshake.local.role == "attn" else handshake.peer
+    if attn.decode_num_microbatches <= 1:
+        return ()
+    return tuple(
+        AFDGraphCaptureVariant(
+            attn_batch_size=attn_batch_size,
+            attn_wire_capacity=attn_wire_capacity,
+            child_wire_capacities=child_wire_capacities,
+            child_compute_capacities=(None,) * len(child_wire_capacities),
+        )
+        for attn_batch_size, attn_wire_capacity, child_wire_capacities in (
+            _build_attn_graph_shapes(attn)
+        )
+        if len(child_wire_capacities) == attn.decode_num_microbatches
+    )
+
+
+def build_afd_graph_capture_plan(
+    handshake: AFDHandshakeResult,
+) -> AFDGraphCapturePlan:
+    if handshake.requires_eager_decode_communication:
+        # F chooses singleton/cohort membership only after receiving A's
+        # control message. Keep NCCL outside the A model graph so that this
+        # late decision does not require paired multi-session graph replay.
+        return AFDGraphCapturePlan(
+            attn_graph_variants=(),
+            ffn_graph_variants=(),
+        )
+
+    attn = handshake.local if handshake.local.role == "attn" else handshake.peer
+    ffn = handshake.local if handshake.local.role == "ffn" else handshake.peer
+    attn_graph_shapes = _build_attn_graph_shapes(attn)
+    attn_graph_capacities = tuple(shape[1] for shape in attn_graph_shapes)
+    if is_direct_afd_backend(attn.afd_backend):
+        if attn_graph_capacities and not ffn.decode_graph_token_buckets:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "AFD direct paired CUDA graph requires FULL graphs on the ffn instance"
+            )
+        return AFDGraphCapturePlan(
+            attn_graph_variants=tuple(
+                AFDGraphCaptureVariant(
+                    attn_batch_size=attn_batch_size,
+                    attn_wire_capacity=attn_wire_capacity,
+                    child_wire_capacities=child_wire_capacities,
+                    child_compute_capacities=(None,) * len(child_wire_capacities),
+                )
+                for (
+                    attn_batch_size,
+                    attn_wire_capacity,
+                    child_wire_capacities,
+                ) in attn_graph_shapes
+            ),
+            ffn_graph_variants=(),
+        )
+
+    transport_buckets = sorted(set(attn.decode_token_buckets))
+    transport_capacities = tuple(reversed(transport_buckets))
+    scattered = attn.afd_ffn_moe_backend == "deepep"
+    wire_token_multiplier = _attn_wire_tokens_per_bs(attn)
+    ffn_max_fan_in = (
+        (attn.num_ranks + ffn.num_ranks - 1) // ffn.num_ranks if scattered else 1
+    )
+    ffn_graph_compatible = not (
+        scattered
+        and ffn.disable_cuda_graph_padding
+        and attn.num_ranks % ffn.num_ranks != 0
+    )
+    ffn_buckets = sorted(set(ffn.decode_graph_token_buckets))
+    if attn.decode_num_microbatches > 1:
+        # Eligible buckets become multi-child parent variants below; only
+        # undersized batches keep a single-child pairing.
+        candidate_capacities = tuple(
+            capacity
+            for capacity in attn_graph_capacities
+            if capacity // wire_token_multiplier < attn.decode_num_microbatches
+        )
+    else:
+        candidate_capacities = (
+            transport_capacities
+            if attn.afd_backend == "nvshmem"
+            else attn_graph_capacities
+        )
+    missing_capacities: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
+    ffn_capacity_by_wire: dict[int, int] = {}
+    for wire_capacity in candidate_capacities:
+        compute_capacity = (
+            _select_ffn_graph_capacity(
+                ffn_buckets,
+                wire_capacity * ffn_max_fan_in,
+                ffn.disable_cuda_graph_padding,
+            )
+            if ffn_graph_compatible
+            else None
+        )
+        if compute_capacity is None:
+            missing_capacities.append((wire_capacity, wire_capacity * ffn_max_fan_in))
+            continue
+        ffn_capacity_by_wire[wire_capacity] = compute_capacity
+
+    if attn.afd_backend == "nccl" and candidate_capacities and not ffn_graph_compatible:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "AFD NCCL communication graph with non-uniform SCATTERED "
+            "fan-in requires F-side CUDA graph padding; remove "
+            "--disable-cuda-graph-padding"
+        )
+    if attn.afd_backend == "nccl" and missing_capacities:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "AFD NCCL communication graph requires an ffn graph bucket for "
+            "every attn graph capacity: "
+            f"missing_edge_to_ffn={missing_capacities}, "
+            f"ffn_buckets={ffn_buckets}"
+        )
+    missing_target_graph_capacities = tuple(
+        missing for missing in missing_capacities if missing[0] in attn_graph_capacities
+    )
+    if attn.decode_num_tokens_per_bs > 1 and missing_target_graph_capacities:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "AFD fixed multi-token target forward requires an ffn graph bucket "
+            "for every attn graph capacity: "
+            f"missing_edge_to_ffn={missing_target_graph_capacities}, "
+            f"ffn_buckets={ffn_buckets}; configure the F decode CUDA graph "
+            "capacity in expert-input rows"
+        )
+
+    attn_variants: list[AFDGraphCaptureVariant] = []
+    for (
+        attn_batch_size,
+        attn_wire_capacity,
+        child_wire_capacities,
+    ) in attn_graph_shapes:
+        if len(child_wire_capacities) > 1:
+            child_compute_capacities = tuple(
+                (
+                    _select_ffn_graph_capacity(
+                        ffn_buckets,
+                        child_wire_capacity * ffn_max_fan_in,
+                        ffn.disable_cuda_graph_padding,
+                    )
+                    if ffn_graph_compatible
+                    else None
+                )
+                for child_wire_capacity in child_wire_capacities
+            )
+            if any(capacity is None for capacity in child_compute_capacities):
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    "AFD microbatch parent communication graph requires an ffn "
+                    "graph bucket for every child: "
+                    f"attn_batch_size={attn_batch_size}, "
+                    f"child_wire_capacities={child_wire_capacities}, "
+                    f"ffn_buckets={ffn_buckets}"
+                )
+        else:
+            child_wire_capacities = (attn_wire_capacity,)
+            child_compute_capacities = (ffn_capacity_by_wire.get(attn_wire_capacity),)
+
+        attn_variants.append(
+            AFDGraphCaptureVariant(
+                attn_batch_size=attn_batch_size,
+                attn_wire_capacity=attn_wire_capacity,
+                child_wire_capacities=child_wire_capacities,
+                child_compute_capacities=child_compute_capacities,
+            )
+        )
+
+    if attn.decode_num_microbatches > 1:
+        # All overlap F graphs are captured in the paired A/F phase via the attn
+        # variants above. Unlike serial NVSHMEM, there are no standalone
+        # transport-only F graph variants.
+        standalone_ffn_variants: tuple[tuple[int, int], ...] = ()
+    else:
+        standalone_ffn_variants = tuple(ffn_capacity_by_wire.items())
+
+    return AFDGraphCapturePlan(
+        attn_graph_variants=tuple(attn_variants),
+        ffn_graph_variants=standalone_ffn_variants,
+    )
+
+
+def parse_ffn_addr(ffn_addr: str) -> Tuple[str, int]:
+    host, _, port = ffn_addr.rpartition(":")
+    if not host or not port.isdigit():
+        raise ValueError(f"Invalid --afd-ffn-addr {ffn_addr!r}, expected host:port")
+    return host, int(port)
+
+
+def compute_model_identity(model_path: str) -> str:
+    """Identity for the A/F model-match check.
+
+    Based on config.json content, NOT on loaded weights: the two sides load
+    disjoint weight subsets, so a weight hash could never match.
+    """
+    config_path = os.path.join(model_path, "config.json")
+    if os.path.isfile(config_path):
+        with open(config_path, "rb") as f:
+            digest = hashlib.sha256(f.read()).hexdigest()[:16]
+    else:
+        # Remote (HF hub) paths are resolved lazily; fall back to the path
+        # string until the checkpoint metadata is available locally.
+        digest = hashlib.sha256(model_path.encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
+    return f"{os.path.basename(os.path.normpath(model_path))}:{digest}"
+
+
+def _check_compatible(local: AFDHandshakeInfo, peer: AFDHandshakeInfo) -> None:
+    if local.role == peer.role:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "AFD handshake: expected one attn role and one ffn role, "
+            f"both sides are {local.role!r}"
+        )
+
+    attn = local if local.role == "attn" else peer
+    ffn = local if local.role == "ffn" else peer
+
+    if attn.model_identity != ffn.model_identity:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"AFD handshake: model mismatch, attn={attn.model_identity!r} "
+            f"ffn={ffn.model_identity!r}"
+        )
+    if attn.afd_backend != ffn.afd_backend:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"AFD handshake: --afd-backend mismatch, attn={attn.afd_backend!r} "
+            f"ffn={ffn.afd_backend!r}"
+        )
+    if is_direct_afd_backend(attn.afd_backend) and (
+        not attn.direct_backend_version
+        or attn.direct_backend_version != ffn.direct_backend_version
+    ):
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "AFD handshake: direct backend component version mismatch, "
+            f"backend={attn.afd_backend!r} "
+            f"attn={attn.direct_backend_version!r} "
+            f"ffn={ffn.direct_backend_version!r}"
+        )
+    if attn.afd_ffn_moe_backend != ffn.afd_ffn_moe_backend:
+        raise RuntimeError(

+                    b"",
+                    msgspec.msgpack.encode(

+                            info=local,
+                            dist_host=dist_host,
+                            sync_port=sync_port,
+                            dist_port=dist_port,

+                    sync_port=sync_port,
+                    dist_port=dist_port,
+                    nvshmem_uid=nvshmem_uid,
+                    session_id=session_id,

+                return self._begin_selected_step(prepared, plan)
+            self._run_inactive_plan(plan)
+            if self._client is not None and not self._client.has_outstanding_proposal:
+                self._send_active_proposal(prepared, proposal_can_run_graph)
+
+    def coordinate_target(self, can_run_graph: bool) -> bool:
+        decision = self.coordinate(can_run_graph)
+        if self._target_graph_decision is not None:
+            raise RuntimeError("AFD Direct target graph decision is already pending")
+        self._target_graph_decision = decision
+        return decision
+
+    def select_model_graph(self, can_run_graph: bool) -> bool:
+        if self._target_graph_decision is not None:
+            decision = self._target_graph_decision
+            self._target_graph_decision = None
+            if decision and not can_run_graph:
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    "AFD Direct target graph eligibility changed after preflight"
+                )
+            return decision
+        return self.coordinate(can_run_graph)
+
+    def on_idle(self) -> None:
+        if self._pending is not None:
+            raise RuntimeError("AFD Direct cannot enter idle with pending work")
+        if self._client is not None:
+            if not self._client.has_outstanding_proposal:
+                self._send_idle_proposal()
+        plan = self._broadcast_plan(block=False)
+        if plan is not None:
+            if plan.active_mask[self._session_id]:
+                raise RuntimeError("AFD Direct selected an idle A instance")
+            self._run_inactive_plan(plan)
+
+    def _broadcast_plan(self, *, block: bool) -> Optional[AFDDirectCommonPlan]:
+        if self._client is not None:
+            plan = (
+                self._client.recv_plan() if block or self._client.poll_plan(1) else None
+            )
+        else:
+            plan = None
+        if get_parallel().tp_size > 1:
+            if self._rank == 0:
+                (plan,) = broadcast_pyobj(
+                    [plan],
+                    self._rank,
+                    self._scheduler.tp_cpu_group,
+                    src=0,
+                )
+            else:
+                (plan,) = broadcast_pyobj(
+                    [],
+                    self._rank,
+                    self._scheduler.tp_cpu_group,
+                    src=0,
+                )
+        if self._rank == 0 and plan is not None and should_log_step(plan.union_step_id):
+            pending_mode = (
+                self._pending.forward_mode
+                if self._pending is not None
+                else ForwardMode.IDLE
+            )
+            pending_tokens = (
+                self._pending.tokens_per_rank
+                if self._pending is not None
+                else (0,) * self._handshake.local.num_ranks
+            )
+            logger.info(
+                "AFD step: side=attn path=direct session=%d union_step=%d "
+                "active=%s "
+                "union_mode=%s pending_mode=%s pending_tokens_per_rank=%s "
+                "parent_wire=%d wire=%d children=%s communication_graph=%s",
+                self._session_id,
+                plan.union_step_id,
+                plan.active_mask[self._session_id],
+                ForwardMode(plan.forward_mode).name,
+                pending_mode.name,
+                pending_tokens,
+                plan.parent_wire_capacity,
+                plan.wire_capacity,
+                plan.child_wire_capacities,
+                plan.communication_graph,
+            )
+        return plan
+
+    def _send_active_proposal(
+        self,
+        prepared: _AFDPreparedAttnStep,
+        can_run_graph: bool,
+    ) -> None:
+        assert self._client is not None
+        self._client.send_proposal(
+            AFDDirectProposal(
+                proposal_id=self._client.next_proposal_id,
+                tokens_per_rank=prepared.tokens_per_rank,
+                forward_mode=int(prepared.forward_mode),
+                wire_capacity=prepared.control_wire_capacity,
+                can_run_graph=can_run_graph,
+                child_wire_capacities=prepared.child_wire_capacities,
+            )
+        )
+
+    def _send_idle_proposal(self) -> None:
+        assert self._client is not None
+        self._client.send_proposal(
+            AFDDirectProposal(
+                proposal_id=self._client.next_proposal_id,
+                tokens_per_rank=(0,) * self._handshake.local.num_ranks,
+                forward_mode=int(ForwardMode.IDLE),
+                wire_capacity=0,
+            )
+        )
+
+    def _begin_selected_step(
+        self,
+        prepared: _AFDPreparedAttnStep,
+        plan: AFDDirectCommonPlan,
+    ) -> bool:
+        if not is_afd_fixed_shape_mode(prepared.forward_mode):
+            self._dispatcher.begin_batch(
+                forward_mode=prepared.forward_mode,
+                dp_capacity=prepared.dp_capacity,
+                wire_capacity=prepared.wire_capacity,
+            )
+            return False
+
+        child_wire_capacities = plan.child_wire_capacities
+        graph_variant = None
+        if plan.communication_graph and len(child_wire_capacities) > 1:
+            graph_variant = self._dispatcher.select_graph_variant(
+                plan.parent_wire_capacity
+            )
+            if (
+                graph_variant is None
+                or graph_variant.child_wire_capacities != child_wire_capacities
+            ):
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    "AFD Direct common plan has no matching local graph variant: "
+                    f"children={child_wire_capacities}"
+                )
+        self._dispatcher.begin_batch(
+            forward_mode=prepared.forward_mode,
+            dp_capacity=prepared.dp_capacity,
+            wire_capacity=plan.wire_capacity,
+            child_wire_capacities=child_wire_capacities,
+            graph_variant=graph_variant,
+        )
+        if plan.communication_graph:
+            num_tokens_per_bs = self._handshake.local.decode_num_tokens_per_bs
+            graph_batch_size = (
+                graph_variant.attn_batch_size
+                if graph_variant is not None
+                else plan.wire_capacity // num_tokens_per_bs
+            )
+            self._scheduler.tp_worker.model_runner.afd_cuda_graph_batch_size = (
+                graph_batch_size
+            )
+        return _decide_afd_attn_graph(
+            plan.communication_graph,
+            self._dispatcher,
+            False,
+        ).use_local_model_graph
+
+    def _run_inactive_plan(self, plan: AFDDirectCommonPlan) -> None:
+        forward_mode = ForwardMode(plan.forward_mode)
+        if is_afd_fixed_shape_mode(forward_mode):
+            # Inactive ranks preserve the active graphs' direct collective
+            # order without N1 host polling.
+            self._dispatcher.run_inactive_direct_step(
+                forward_mode,
+                plan.wire_capacity,
+                plan.child_wire_capacities,
+                do_cpu_sync=False if plan.communication_graph else None,
+            )
+
+
+def _decide_afd_attn_graph(
+    can_run_graph: bool,
+    dispatcher: AFDDispatcher,
+    force_eager_communication: bool,
+) -> AFDAttnGraphDecision:
+    use_paired_communication_graph = dispatcher.select_paired_communication_graph(
+        False if force_eager_communication else can_run_graph
+    )
+    if dispatcher.current_num_children > 1:
+        use_local_model_graph = dispatcher.select_parent_graph_variant(
+            can_run_graph
+            if force_eager_communication
+            else use_paired_communication_graph
+        )
+    else:
+        use_local_model_graph = (
+            can_run_graph
+            if force_eager_communication
+            else use_paired_communication_graph
+        )
+    return AFDAttnGraphDecision(
+        use_local_model_graph=use_local_model_graph,
+        use_paired_communication_graph=use_paired_communication_graph,
+    )
+
+
+def _tokens_per_rank(batch: ScheduleBatch, num_attn_ranks: int) -> list[int]:
+    # Only mirror cross-DP padding when the model uses that layout. A replayed
+    # graph may add a separate fixed-stride layer through wire_capacity.
+    model_uses_cross_dp_layout = (
+        batch.global_num_tokens is not None and len(batch.global_num_tokens) > 1
+    )
+    if batch.global_num_tokens_across_dp is not None:
+        tokens = list(batch.global_num_tokens_across_dp)
+    elif batch.global_num_tokens is not None:
+        tokens = list(batch.global_num_tokens)
+    elif batch.forward_mode.is_idle():
+        tokens = [0]
+    elif batch.forward_mode.is_decode():
+        tokens = [batch.batch_size()]
+    else:
+        tokens = [batch.extend_num_tokens]
+
+    if len(tokens) != num_attn_ranks:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"tokens_per_rank has {len(tokens)} entries but the attn instance "
+            f"has {num_attn_ranks} ranks"
+        )
+    if model_uses_cross_dp_layout and len(tokens) > 1:
+        from sglang.srt.layers.dp_attention import DpPaddingMode
+
+        padding_mode = DpPaddingMode.get_dp_padding_mode(
+            batch.is_extend_in_batch, tokens
+        )
+        if padding_mode.is_max_len():
+            tokens = [max(tokens)] * len(tokens)
+    return tokens
+
+
+def _effective_forward_mode(
+    batch: ScheduleBatch, tokens_per_rank: Sequence[int]
+) -> ForwardMode:
+    if batch.global_forward_mode is not None:
+        return ForwardMode(batch.global_forward_mode)
+    if batch.global_num_tokens is None:
+        return batch.forward_mode
+    if batch.is_extend_in_batch:
+        return ForwardMode.EXTEND
+    if sum(tokens_per_rank) > 0:
+        return ForwardMode.DECODE
+    return ForwardMode.IDLE
+
+
+def _select_child_wire_capacities(
+    tokens_per_rank: Sequence[int],
+    token_buckets: Sequence[int],
+    num_microbatches: int,
+    *,
+    scattered: bool,
+    num_tokens_per_bs: int = 1,
+) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+    logical_batch_sizes = [
+        num_tokens // num_tokens_per_bs for num_tokens in tokens_per_rank
+    ]
+    if any(batch_size < num_microbatches for batch_size in logical_batch_sizes):
+        return ()
+    per_rank_child_sizes = [
+        tuple(
+            child_batch_size * num_tokens_per_bs
+            for child_batch_size in split_afd_batch_size(batch_size, num_microbatches)
+        )
+        for batch_size in logical_batch_sizes
+    ]
+    return tuple(
+        select_token_bucket(
+            token_buckets,
+            max(child_sizes) if scattered else sum(child_sizes),
+        )
+        for child_sizes in zip(*per_rank_child_sizes, strict=True)
+    )
+
+
+def _prepare_afd_attn_step(
+    scheduler: Scheduler,
+    *,
+    tokens_per_rank: Sequence[int],
+    forward_mode: ForwardMode,
+    can_run_decode_cuda_graph: bool,
+    microbatch_tokens_per_rank: Optional[Sequence[int]] = None,
+) -> bool:
+    dispatcher = get_afd_dispatcher()
+    num_attn_ranks = scheduler.afd_handshake.local.num_ranks
+    tokens_per_rank = list(tokens_per_rank)
+    if len(tokens_per_rank) != num_attn_ranks:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"tokens_per_rank has {len(tokens_per_rank)} entries but the attn "
+            f"instance has {num_attn_ranks} ranks"
+        )
+    if any(num_tokens < 0 for num_tokens in tokens_per_rank):
+        raise RuntimeError("AFD tokens_per_rank cannot contain negative values")
+    total_tokens = sum(tokens_per_rank)
+
+    model_runner = scheduler.tp_worker.model_runner
+    num_tokens_per_bs = scheduler.afd_handshake.local.decode_num_tokens_per_bs
+    if forward_mode.is_target_verify():
+        if any(num_tokens % num_tokens_per_bs != 0 for num_tokens in tokens_per_rank):
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "AFD TARGET_VERIFY token counts must be divisible by the "
+                "negotiated rows per request: "
+                f"tokens_per_rank={tokens_per_rank}, "
+                f"rows_per_request={num_tokens_per_bs}"
+            )
+        logical_batch_sizes = [
+            num_tokens // num_tokens_per_bs for num_tokens in tokens_per_rank
+        ]
+        model_runner.afd_cuda_graph_batch_size = (
+            max(logical_batch_sizes) if total_tokens > 0 else None
+        )
+    else:
+        model_runner.afd_cuda_graph_batch_size = (
+            max(tokens_per_rank) if forward_mode.is_decode() else None
+        )
+
+    scattered = get_disagg().afd_ffn_moe_backend == "deepep"
+    dp_capacity = tokens_per_rank[get_parallel().tp_rank] if scattered else total_tokens
+    if is_afd_fixed_shape_mode(forward_mode):
+        minimum_wire_capacity = (
+            max(tokens_per_rank)
+            if scattered
+            else (
+                max(tokens_per_rank) * num_attn_ranks
+                if get_exec().graph.cuda_graph_config.decode.backend != Backend.DISABLED
+                else dp_capacity
+            )
+        )
+        wire_capacity = select_token_bucket(
+            scheduler.afd_handshake.local.decode_token_buckets,
+            minimum_wire_capacity,
+        )
+        control_wire_capacity = wire_capacity
+    else:
+        wire_capacity = dp_capacity
+        control_wire_capacity = (
+            max(tokens_per_rank, default=0) if scattered else wire_capacity
+        )
+    child_wire_capacities: tuple[int, ...] = ()
+    parent_graph_variant: Optional[AFDGraphCaptureVariant] = None
+    num_microbatches = get_disagg().afd_decode_num_microbatches
+    fixed_shape_decode = forward_mode.is_decode() or forward_mode.is_target_verify()
+    # A captured parent bucket owns its child topology. Low-load DP ranks mask
+    # padded children; only the eager fallback requires nonempty children.
+    # Without padding, the runner requires an exact logical batch-size match.
+    if num_microbatches > 1 and fixed_shape_decode and can_run_decode_cuda_graph:
+        graph_variant = dispatcher.select_graph_variant(minimum_wire_capacity)
+        if (
+            graph_variant is not None
+            and len(graph_variant.child_wire_capacities) == num_microbatches
+            and (
+                not get_exec().graph.disable_cuda_graph_padding
+                or graph_variant.attn_batch_size
+                == model_runner.afd_cuda_graph_batch_size
+            )
+        ):
+            parent_graph_variant = graph_variant
+            child_wire_capacities = graph_variant.child_wire_capacities
+
+    eager_tokens_per_rank = (
+        tokens_per_rank
+        if microbatch_tokens_per_rank is None
+        else microbatch_tokens_per_rank
+    )
+    eager_rows_per_request = num_tokens_per_bs if forward_mode.is_target_verify() else 1
+    can_split_eager = (
+        num_microbatches > 1
+        and fixed_shape_decode
+        and all(
+            num_tokens >= num_microbatches * eager_rows_per_request
+            for num_tokens in eager_tokens_per_rank
+        )
+    )
+    eager_child_wire_capacities = (
+        _select_child_wire_capacities(
+            tokens_per_rank,
+            scheduler.afd_handshake.local.decode_token_buckets,
+            num_microbatches,
+            scattered=scattered,
+            num_tokens_per_bs=eager_rows_per_request,
+        )
+        if can_split_eager
+        else ()
+    )
+    if not child_wire_capacities:
+        child_wire_capacities = eager_child_wire_capacities
+    uses_microbatch_overlap = len(child_wire_capacities) > 1
+    if uses_microbatch_overlap:
+        wire_capacity = sum(child_wire_capacities)
+        control_wire_capacity = wire_capacity
+    else:
+        child_wire_capacities = ()
+        parent_graph_variant = None
+
+    paired_graph_preflight = False
+    if fixed_shape_decode and total_tokens > 0:
+        if uses_microbatch_overlap:
+            paired_graph_preflight = parent_graph_variant is not None
+        elif control_wire_capacity in (
+            scheduler.afd_handshake.local.decode_graph_token_buckets
+        ):
+            if num_microbatches == 1:
+                paired_graph_preflight = True
+            else:
+                graph_wire_tokens_per_bs = num_tokens_per_bs * (
+                    1 if scattered else num_attn_ranks
+                )
+                graph_batch_size = control_wire_capacity // graph_wire_tokens_per_bs
+                paired_graph_preflight = graph_batch_size < num_microbatches
+
+    direct_coordinator = scheduler._afd_attn_coordinator
+    if direct_coordinator is not None:
+        direct_coordinator.stage(
+            _AFDPreparedAttnStep(
+                tokens_per_rank=tuple(tokens_per_rank),
+                forward_mode=forward_mode,
+                dp_capacity=dp_capacity,
+                wire_capacity=wire_capacity,
+                control_wire_capacity=control_wire_capacity,
+                child_wire_capacities=eager_child_wire_capacities,
+                paired_graph_preflight=paired_graph_preflight,
+            )
+        )
+        return paired_graph_preflight
+
+    step_id = dispatcher.begin_batch(
+        forward_mode=forward_mode,
+        dp_capacity=dp_capacity,
+        wire_capacity=wire_capacity,
+        child_wire_capacities=child_wire_capacities,
+        graph_variant=parent_graph_variant,
+    )
+    if scheduler._afd_sync_sender is not None:
+        scheduler._afd_sync_sender.prepare_for_batch(
+            step_id=step_id,
+            tokens_per_rank=tokens_per_rank,
+            forward_mode=forward_mode,
+            wire_capacity=control_wire_capacity,
+            child_wire_capacities=child_wire_capacities,
+        )
+
+    return paired_graph_preflight if forward_mode.is_target_verify() else False
+
+
+def prepare_afd_attn_batch(scheduler: Scheduler, batch: ScheduleBatch) -> None:
+    if scheduler.spec_algorithm.is_speculative():
+        forward_mode = (
+            ForwardMode(batch.global_forward_mode)
+            if batch.global_forward_mode is not None
+            else batch.forward_mode
+        )
+        if not (
+            forward_mode.is_extend_without_speculative() or batch.is_extend_in_batch
+        ):
+            return
+
+    num_attn_ranks = scheduler.afd_handshake.local.num_ranks
+    tokens_per_rank = _tokens_per_rank(batch, num_attn_ranks)
+    forward_mode = _effective_forward_mode(batch, tokens_per_rank)
+    _prepare_afd_attn_step(
+        scheduler,
+        tokens_per_rank=tokens_per_rank,
+        forward_mode=forward_mode,
+        can_run_decode_cuda_graph=batch.can_run_decode_cuda_graph,
+    )
+
+
+def init_afd_mlp_sync_metadata(
+    forward_batch: ForwardBatch,
+    batch: ScheduleBatch,
+    model_runner,
+) -> None:
+    from sglang.srt.speculative.spec_info import SpecInputType
+
+    is_dspark_target_verify = (
+        batch.spec_info is not None
+        and batch.spec_info.spec_input_type == SpecInputType.DFLASH_VERIFY
+    )
+    if not model_runner.is_draft_worker and not is_dspark_target_verify:
+        forward_batch.init_mlp_sync_metadata(
+            batch, model_runner.device, is_draft_worker=model_runner.is_draft_worker
+        )
+        forward_batch.original_global_num_tokens_cpu = batch.global_num_tokens_across_dp
+        return
+
+    global_num_tokens = batch.global_num_tokens_across_dp
+    forward_batch.original_global_num_tokens_cpu = global_num_tokens
+    global_num_tokens_for_logprob = batch.global_num_tokens_for_logprob_across_dp
+    if batch.spec_info is not None:
+        global_num_tokens, global_num_tokens_for_logprob = spec_scale_global_num_tokens(
+            batch.spec_info, global_num_tokens, global_num_tokens_for_logprob
+        )
+
+    forward_batch.global_num_tokens_cpu = global_num_tokens
+    forward_batch.global_num_tokens_gpu = torch.tensor(
+        global_num_tokens, dtype=torch.int64
+    ).to(model_runner.device, non_blocking=True)
+    forward_batch.global_num_tokens_for_logprob_cpu = global_num_tokens_for_logprob
+    forward_batch.global_num_tokens_for_logprob_gpu = torch.tensor(
+        global_num_tokens_for_logprob,
+        dtype=torch.int64,
+    ).to(model_runner.device, non_blocking=True)
+
+
+def prepare_afd_attn_forward_batch(
+    scheduler: Scheduler, forward_batch: ForwardBatch
+) -> bool:
+    spec_info = forward_batch.spec_info
+    if spec_info is None or not spec_info.is_verify_input():
+        raise RuntimeError("AFD target preparation requires speculative verify input")
+
+    num_tokens_per_bs = spec_info.num_tokens_per_req
+    negotiated_num_tokens_per_bs = (
+        scheduler.afd_handshake.local.decode_num_tokens_per_bs
+    )
+    if num_tokens_per_bs != negotiated_num_tokens_per_bs:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "AFD target verify width changed after startup: "
+            f"runtime={num_tokens_per_bs}, "
+            f"negotiated={negotiated_num_tokens_per_bs}"
+        )
+
+    num_attn_ranks = scheduler.afd_handshake.local.num_ranks
+    global_num_tokens = forward_batch.original_global_num_tokens_cpu
+    if global_num_tokens is not None:
+        tokens_per_rank = [count * num_tokens_per_bs for count in global_num_tokens]
+        microbatch_tokens_per_rank = list(tokens_per_rank)
+        model_uses_cross_dp_layout = (
+            forward_batch.global_num_tokens_cpu is not None
+            and len(forward_batch.global_num_tokens_cpu) > 1
+        )
+        if model_uses_cross_dp_layout:
+            from sglang.srt.layers.dp_attention import DpPaddingMode
+
+            padding_mode = DpPaddingMode.get_dp_padding_mode(
+                forward_batch.is_extend_in_batch,
+                tokens_per_rank,
+            )
+            if padding_mode.is_max_len():
+                tokens_per_rank = [max(tokens_per_rank)] * len(tokens_per_rank)
+    else:
+        if num_attn_ranks != 1:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "AFD multi-rank target verify requires global token counts"
+            )
+        tokens_per_rank = [forward_batch.input_ids.shape[0]]
+        microbatch_tokens_per_rank = list(tokens_per_rank)
+
+    forward_mode = (
+        ForwardMode.TARGET_VERIFY if sum(tokens_per_rank) > 0 else ForwardMode.IDLE
+    )
+    paired_graph_preflight = _prepare_afd_attn_step(
+        scheduler,
+        tokens_per_rank=tokens_per_rank,
+        forward_mode=forward_mode,
+        can_run_decode_cuda_graph=forward_batch.can_run_decode_cuda_graph,
+        microbatch_tokens_per_rank=microbatch_tokens_per_rank,
+    )
+    direct_coordinator = scheduler._afd_attn_coordinator
+    if direct_coordinator is None:
+        return paired_graph_preflight
+    model_runner = scheduler.tp_worker.model_runner
+    can_run_graph = bool(
+        paired_graph_preflight
+        and forward_batch.forward_mode.is_cuda_graph()
+        and model_runner.decode_cuda_graph_runner
+        and model_runner.decode_cuda_graph_runner.can_run_graph(forward_batch)
+    )
+    return direct_coordinator.coordinate_target(can_run_graph)
+
+
+def init_afd_attn(
+    scheduler: Scheduler,
+) -> tuple[AFDHandshakeResult, Optional[AFDSyncSender]]:
+    """Attn-side init: rank 0 handshakes, every rank gets the result.
+
+    Ranks other than the global sender rank need the handshake result too
+    (topology / negotiated ports) to build their data-plane comm backend.
+    Returns (handshake, sync_sender); the sender is None off the sender rank.
+    """
+    rank = get_parallel().tp_rank
+    is_sender_rank = rank == 0  # pp_size == 1 is enforced for AFD
+    rank_node_ids, rank_nvshmem_fabric_keys = gather_nvshmem_topology(scheduler)
+    if is_sender_rank:
+        handshake = run_handshake_attn(
+            get_disagg().afd_ffn_addr,
+            build_local_handshake_info(
+                scheduler,
+                AFDRole.ATTN,
+                rank_node_ids,
+                rank_nvshmem_fabric_keys,
+            ),
+        )
+        if get_parallel().tp_size > 1:
+            broadcast_pyobj([handshake], rank, get_parallel().tp_group.cpu_group, src=0)
+    else:
+        (handshake,) = broadcast_pyobj(
+            [], rank, get_parallel().tp_group.cpu_group, src=0
+        )
+
+    force_eager_communication = handshake.requires_eager_decode_communication
+    decode_config = get_exec().graph.cuda_graph_config.decode
+    if force_eager_communication and decode_config.backend == Backend.FULL:
+        logger.info(
+            "AFD NCCL cohort: switching the attn decode CUDA graph backend "
+            "from full to breakable for eager remote-expert communication"
+        )
+        get_context().override(
+            "afd_cohort_decode_graph",
+            cuda_graph_config=with_phase(
+                get_exec().graph.cuda_graph_config,
+                Phase.DECODE,
+                backend=Backend.BREAKABLE,
+            ),
+        )
+
+    plan = build_afd_graph_capture_plan(handshake)
+    backend = init_afd_comm_backend(scheduler, AFDRole.ATTN, handshake)
+    dispatcher = _init_afd_attn_dispatcher(scheduler, backend, handshake)
+    direct_multi_attn = (
+        is_direct_afd_backend(handshake.local.afd_backend)

+    if local_graph_variants:

+    # control-plane sender and publishes it to F.

+    scheduler.tp_worker.model_runner.afd_target_verify_prepare_callback = (
+        lambda forward_batch: prepare_afd_attn_forward_batch(scheduler, forward_batch)
+    )
+    return handshake, sync_sender

+"""AFD control plane: per-step sync messages between attn and ffn instances.
+
+The control plane carries per-step metadata (ZMQ, CPU). Decode uses it with
+the handshake-time bucket list to select fixed-capacity data-plane tensors;
+the serial prefill fallback still uses exact-size tensors.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import logging
+from typing import List, Optional
+
+import msgspec
+import zmq
+
+from sglang.srt.utils.network import get_zmq_socket
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+class AFDSyncMsg(msgspec.Struct, tag="sync", forbid_unknown_fields=True):
+    """Per-step forward metadata, sent immediately before the attn forward.
+
+    ``child_wire_capacities`` describes the ordered children of an opt-in
+    microbatch-overlap parent. It is empty for the existing serial path.
+    """
+
+    step_id: int
+    # Effective token slots per attn DP rank after native DP padding.
+    tokens_per_rank: List[int]
+    forward_mode: int  # ForwardMode value (extend/decode/idle/...)
+    # Common decode bucket. Eager SCATTERED prefill derives each pair's exact
+    # first dimension from tokens_per_rank instead.
+    wire_capacity: int
+    # Final A-side graph decision. NCCL requires both peers to either replay
+    # their paired graphs or execute eagerly for a given step.
+    communication_graph: bool = False
+    # Ordered child wire capacities for the opt-in decode-overlap parent. Empty
+    # keeps the existing single-work path.
+    child_wire_capacities: tuple[int, ...] = ()
+
+    @property
+    def effective_child_wire_capacities(self) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+        """Ordered child capacities, including serial work as one child."""
+        return self.child_wire_capacities or (self.wire_capacity,)
+
+
+class AFDDirectProposal(
+    msgspec.Struct, tag="proposal", frozen=True, forbid_unknown_fields=True
+):
+    """One attn instance's candidate work for the next Direct union step."""
+
+    proposal_id: int
+    tokens_per_rank: tuple[int, ...]
+    forward_mode: int
+    wire_capacity: int
+    can_run_graph: bool = False
+    child_wire_capacities: tuple[int, ...] = ()
+
+
+class AFDDirectCommonPlan(
+    msgspec.Struct, tag="plan", frozen=True, forbid_unknown_fields=True
+):
+    """F-selected union-wide execution plan returned to every attn instance."""
+
+    union_step_id: int
+    observed_proposal_ids: tuple[int, ...]
+    active_mask: tuple[bool, ...]
+    forward_mode: int
+    parent_wire_capacity: int
+    wire_capacity: int
+    communication_graph: bool = False
+    child_wire_capacities: tuple[int, ...] = ()
+
+
+def _check_direct_plan(
+    plan: AFDDirectCommonPlan,
+    session_id: int,
+    proposal: AFDDirectProposal,
+    union_step_id: int,
+) -> bool:
+    if plan.union_step_id != union_step_id:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "AFD Direct union_step_id out of order: "
+            f"expected {union_step_id}, got {plan.union_step_id}"
+        )
+    if len(plan.observed_proposal_ids) != len(plan.active_mask):
+        raise RuntimeError("AFD Direct proposal ids and active mask size mismatch")
+    if session_id >= len(plan.active_mask):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"AFD Direct plan does not contain session {session_id}")
+    observed_proposal_id = plan.observed_proposal_ids[session_id]
+    active = plan.active_mask[session_id]
+    if observed_proposal_id > proposal.proposal_id:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "AFD Direct plan observed a future proposal for session "
+            f"{session_id}: current={proposal.proposal_id}, "
+            f"observed={observed_proposal_id}"
+        )
+    if active and observed_proposal_id != proposal.proposal_id:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "AFD Direct plan selected the wrong proposal for session "
+            f"{session_id}: current={proposal.proposal_id}, "
+            f"observed={observed_proposal_id}"
+        )
+    return observed_proposal_id == proposal.proposal_id
+
+
+_sync_decoder = msgspec.msgpack.Decoder(AFDSyncMsg)
+_proposal_decoder = msgspec.msgpack.Decoder(AFDDirectProposal)
+_plan_decoder = msgspec.msgpack.Decoder(AFDDirectCommonPlan)
+
+
+class AFDSyncMsgSender:
+    """Attn side: PUSH socket owned by the single global sender rank."""
+
+    def __init__(self, endpoint: str):
+        self._socket = get_zmq_socket(
+            zmq.Context.instance(), zmq.PUSH, endpoint, bind=False
+        )
+
+    def send(self, msg: AFDSyncMsg) -> None:
+        self._socket.send(msgspec.msgpack.encode(msg))
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        self._socket.close(linger=0)
+
+
+class AFDSyncMsgReceiver:
+    """Ffn side: PULL socket bound by rank 0 of the ffn instance."""
+
+    def __init__(self, endpoint: str):
+        self._socket = get_zmq_socket(
+            zmq.Context.instance(), zmq.PULL, endpoint, bind=True
+        )
+        self._last_step_id: Optional[int] = None
+        logger.info("AFD control receiver bound at %s", endpoint)
+
+    @property
+    def socket(self) -> zmq.Socket:
+        return self._socket
+
+    def recv(self) -> AFDSyncMsg:
+        """Blocking receive. Asserts step_id monotonicity (fail-fast on
+        reordering/loss instead of silently desyncing with the attn side)."""
+        msg = _sync_decoder.decode(self._socket.recv())
+        expected = 0 if self._last_step_id is None else self._last_step_id + 1
+        if msg.step_id != expected:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"AFD control step_id out of order: expected {expected}, "
+                f"got {msg.step_id}"
+            )
+        self._last_step_id = msg.step_id
+        return msg
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        self._socket.close(linger=0)
+
+
+class AFDDirectControlClient:
+    """Attn-side PAIR channel for Direct union-step planning."""
+
+    def __init__(self, endpoint: str, session_id: int):
+        if session_id < 0:
+            raise ValueError("AFD Direct session_id must be non-negative")
+        self._session_id = session_id
+        self._socket = get_zmq_socket(
+            zmq.Context.instance(), zmq.PAIR, endpoint, bind=False
+        )
+        self._next_proposal_id = 0
+        self._next_union_step_id = 0
+        self._outstanding_proposal: Optional[AFDDirectProposal] = None
+
+    @property
+    def next_proposal_id(self) -> int:
+        return self._next_proposal_id
+
+    @property
+    def has_outstanding_proposal(self) -> bool:
+        return self._outstanding_proposal is not None
+
+    def send_proposal(self, proposal: AFDDirectProposal) -> None:
+        outstanding = self._outstanding_proposal
+        if outstanding is not None and not (
+            sum(outstanding.tokens_per_rank) == 0 and sum(proposal.tokens_per_rank) > 0
+        ):
+            raise RuntimeError("AFD Direct client already has an outstanding proposal")
+        if proposal.proposal_id != self._next_proposal_id:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "AFD Direct proposal_id out of order: "
+                f"expected {self._next_proposal_id}, got {proposal.proposal_id}"
+            )
+        self._socket.send(msgspec.msgpack.encode(proposal))
+        self._outstanding_proposal = proposal
+        self._next_proposal_id += 1
+
+    def recv_plan(self) -> AFDDirectCommonPlan:
+        outstanding = self._outstanding_proposal
+        if outstanding is None:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "AFD Direct client cannot receive a plan without a proposal"
+            )
+        plan = _plan_decoder.decode(self._socket.recv())
+        consumed_current = _check_direct_plan(
+            plan,
+            self._session_id,
+            outstanding,
+            self._next_union_step_id,
+        )
+        if consumed_current:
+            self._outstanding_proposal = None
+        self._next_union_step_id += 1
+        return plan
+
+    def poll_plan(self, timeout_ms: int = 0) -> bool:
+        return bool(self._socket.poll(timeout_ms, zmq.POLLIN) & zmq.POLLIN)
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        self._socket.close(linger=0)
+
+
+class AFDDirectControlServer:
+    """F-side PAIR channel for one Direct attn session."""
+
+    def __init__(self, endpoint: str, session_id: int):
+        if session_id < 0:
+            raise ValueError("AFD Direct session_id must be non-negative")
+        self._session_id = session_id
+        self._socket = get_zmq_socket(
+            zmq.Context.instance(), zmq.PAIR, endpoint, bind=True
+        )
+        self._next_proposal_id = 0
+        self._outstanding_proposal: Optional[AFDDirectProposal] = None
+        logger.info(
+            "AFD Direct control server bound at %s for session %d",
+            endpoint,
+            session_id,
+        )
+
+    @property
+    def socket(self) -> zmq.Socket:
+        return self._socket
+
+    def recv_proposal(self) -> AFDDirectProposal:
+        outstanding = self._outstanding_proposal
+        if outstanding is not None and sum(outstanding.tokens_per_rank) != 0:
+            raise RuntimeError("AFD Direct server already has an outstanding proposal")
+        proposal = _proposal_decoder.decode(self._socket.recv())
+        if proposal.proposal_id != self._next_proposal_id:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "AFD Direct proposal_id out of order for session "
+                f"{self._session_id}: expected {self._next_proposal_id}, "
+                f"got {proposal.proposal_id}"
+            )
+        if outstanding is not None and sum(proposal.tokens_per_rank) == 0:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "AFD Direct can only replace an idle proposal with active work"
+            )
+        self._outstanding_proposal = proposal
+        self._next_proposal_id += 1
+        return proposal
+
+    def send_plan(self, plan: AFDDirectCommonPlan) -> None:
+        if self._outstanding_proposal is None:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "AFD Direct server cannot send a plan without a proposal"
+            )
+        self._socket.send(msgspec.msgpack.encode(plan))
+        self._outstanding_proposal = None
+
+    def close(self) -> None:
+        self._socket.close(linger=0)

+"""AFD data-plane backend abstraction.
+
+The data plane moves per-layer MoE tensors (hidden states, topk ids/weights,
+expert outputs) between attn and ffn ranks. Tensor sizes are never negotiated
+here: both sides receive the exact wire capacity from the control plane and
+provide matching views.
+
+Joint logical/NCCL rank layout: ffn ranks come first, followed by each attn
+instance in handshake order: [F][A0][A1].... This makes ffn rank 0 the global
+rank 0, which hosts the rendezvous store — consistent with the ffn instance
+being the passive server side whose address the attn instances already know
+(--afd-ffn-addr).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Sequence
+
+from sglang.srt.afd.afd_config import AFDRole
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    import torch
+
+    from sglang.srt.afd.afd_handshake import AFDHandshakeResult
+    from sglang.srt.afd.comm.nvshmem import NVSHMEMRuntimeOwner
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class AFDCommConfig:
+    role: AFDRole
+    # Total attn ranks in this communicator. For staged/single-A backends this
+    # is also the local attn instance size.
+    num_attn_ranks: int
+    num_ffn_ranks: int
+    # Attn ranks visible to this backend view: one session for staged backends
+    # and Direct A ranks, and the full Direct union on F ranks.
+    num_local_attn_ranks: int
+    # Rank within the local instance (attn: DP rank; ffn: local TP rank).
+    instance_rank: int
+    # Rendezvous store endpoint on the ffn side (host from --afd-ffn-addr on
+    # the attn side; port negotiated in the handshake).
+    store_host: str
+    store_port: int
+    device: str
+    # Static multi-A placement within the communicator's contiguous attn rank
+    # range.
+    attn_instance_rank_offset: int = 0
+
+    def __post_init__(self):
+        if self.num_attn_ranks <= 0 or self.num_ffn_ranks <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("AFD communicator rank counts must be positive")
+        if self.num_local_attn_ranks <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("AFD local attn rank count must be positive")
+        if not (
+            0
+            <= self.attn_instance_rank_offset
+            <= self.num_attn_ranks - self.num_local_attn_ranks
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "AFD attn instance rank range is outside the communicator: "
+                f"offset={self.attn_instance_rank_offset}, "
+                f"local={self.num_local_attn_ranks}, total={self.num_attn_ranks}"
+            )
+        num_local = (
+            self.num_local_attn_ranks if self.role.is_attn() else self.num_ffn_ranks
+        )
+        if not 0 <= self.instance_rank < num_local:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"instance_rank {self.instance_rank} out of range for "
+                f"{num_local} {self.role.value} ranks"
+            )
+
+    @property
+    def world_size(self) -> int:
+        return self.num_attn_ranks + self.num_ffn_ranks
+
+    @property
+    def global_rank(self) -> int:
+        if self.role.is_ffn():
+            return self.instance_rank
+        return self.num_ffn_ranks + self.attn_instance_rank_offset + self.instance_rank
+
+    def ffn_ranks_for_attn(self, attn_rank: int, *, scattered: bool) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+        union_attn_rank = self.attn_instance_rank_offset + attn_rank
+        if scattered:
+            return (union_attn_rank % self.num_ffn_ranks,)
+        return tuple(range(union_attn_rank, self.num_ffn_ranks, self.num_attn_ranks))
+
+    def attn_ranks_for_ffn(self, ffn_rank: int, *, scattered: bool) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+        if scattered:
+            return tuple(
+                range(
+                    ffn_rank,
+                    self.num_local_attn_ranks,
+                    self.num_ffn_ranks,
+                )
+            )
+        return (ffn_rank % self.num_local_attn_ranks,)
+
+    def ffn_global_rank(self, ffn_rank: int) -> int:
+        return ffn_rank
+
+    def attn_global_rank(self, attn_rank: int) -> int:
+        return self.num_ffn_ranks + self.attn_instance_rank_offset + attn_rank
+
+
+class AFDCommBackend(ABC):
+    """Point-to-point transport between attn and ffn ranks.
+
+    All tensors must be contiguous and identically sized on both peers.
+    Decode transfers use bucket-capacity views; the prefill fallback still
+    uses exact-size tensors. Recv methods fill the given tensors in place.
+
+    Every operation must be ordered on the caller's current device stream, or
+    establish equivalent stream dependencies. Returning means the transfer is
+    enqueued, not complete. Fixed-slot callers may reuse a slot after its ordered
+    response and downstream consumers have been enqueued on the same stream.
+    Independent-stream implementations require an explicit completion/fence.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, config: AFDCommConfig):
+        self.config = config
+
+    @property
+    def decode_transport(self) -> NVSHMEMRuntimeOwner | None:
+        return None
+
+    @property
+    def nccl_comm_ptr(self) -> int | None:
+        """Raw joint-world NCCL communicator for fused data planes."""
+        return None
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def send_to(
+        self,
+        tensors: Sequence[torch.Tensor],
+        peer_global_rank: int,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Enqueue tensors to an explicit rank in the joint communicator."""
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def recv_from(
+        self,
+        tensors: Sequence[torch.Tensor],
+        peer_global_rank: int,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Receive tensors from an explicit rank in the joint communicator."""
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def startup_barrier(self) -> None:
+        """Synchronize the joint attn+ffn group during startup."""
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def close(self) -> None: ...
+
+
+def create_afd_comm_backend(
+    backend: str,
+    config: AFDCommConfig,
+    *,
+    handshake: AFDHandshakeResult | None = None,
+) -> AFDCommBackend:
+    if backend == "nccl":
+        from sglang.srt.afd.comm.nccl import NCCLCommBackend
+
+        return NCCLCommBackend(config)
+    if backend == "nvshmem":
+        if handshake is None or handshake.nvshmem_uid is None:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "AFD NVSHMEM backend requires a completed handshake with a unique ID"
+            )
+        from sglang.srt.afd.comm.nvshmem import NVSHMEMCommBackend
+
+        return NVSHMEMCommBackend(config=config, handshake=handshake)
+    raise ValueError(f"Unknown AFD comm backend {backend!r}")

+"""NCCL data-plane backend.
+
+Builds a joint attn∪ffn NCCL communicator with StatelessProcessGroup +
+PyNcclCommunicator (the pattern proven by update_weights_from_distributed:
+it forms a new group across processes whose default torch.distributed
+groups are already initialized, without polluting global state).
+
+All ops are asynchronous w.r.t. the CPU and ordered on the current CUDA stream.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import logging
+from typing import Sequence
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.afd.comm.base import AFDCommBackend, AFDCommConfig
+from sglang.srt.distributed.device_communicators.pynccl import PyNcclCommunicator
+from sglang.srt.distributed.utils import StatelessProcessGroup
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+class NCCLCommBackend(AFDCommBackend):
+    def __init__(self, config: AFDCommConfig):
+        super().__init__(config)
+        num_local_ranks = (
+            config.num_local_attn_ranks
+            if config.role.is_attn()
+            else config.num_ffn_ranks
+        )
+        logger.info(
+            "AFD NCCL backend init: role=%s local_rank=%d/%d global_rank=%d/%d "
+            "store=%s:%d device=%s",
+            config.role.value,
+            config.instance_rank,
+            num_local_ranks,
+            config.global_rank,
+            config.world_size,
+            config.store_host,
+            config.store_port,
+            config.device,
+        )
+        self._pg = StatelessProcessGroup.create(
+            host=config.store_host,
+            port=config.store_port,
+            rank=config.global_rank,
+            world_size=config.world_size,
+        )
+        self._comm = PyNcclCommunicator(self._pg, device=config.device)
+        if not self._comm.available:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "AFD NCCL backend: NCCL library unavailable on this platform"
+            )
+        # PyNcclCommunicator constructs itself disabled (its ops silently
+        # no-op); AFD always drives it explicitly.
+        self._comm.disabled = False
+        logger.info(
+            "AFD NCCL backend ready: global_rank=%d/%d",
+            config.global_rank,
+            config.world_size,
+        )
+
+    @property
+    def nccl_comm_ptr(self) -> int:
+        comm_ptr = self._comm.comm.value
+        if comm_ptr is None:
+            raise RuntimeError("AFD NCCL communicator has no device handle")
+        return int(comm_ptr)
+
+    def send_to(
+        self,
+        tensors: Sequence[torch.Tensor],
+        peer_global_rank: int,
+    ) -> None:
+        self._transfer(tensors, send=True, peer=peer_global_rank)
+
+    def recv_from(
+        self,
+        tensors: Sequence[torch.Tensor],
+        peer_global_rank: int,
+    ) -> None:
+        self._transfer(tensors, send=False, peer=peer_global_rank)
+
+    def startup_barrier(self) -> None:
+        self._pg.barrier()
+
+    def create_process_group(
+        self,
+        *,
+        rank: int,
+        group_name: str,
+    ) -> torch.distributed.ProcessGroup:
+        """Create a torch ProcessGroup over the existing joint-world store."""
+        from sglang.srt.utils.common import init_custom_process_group
+
+        return init_custom_process_group(
+            backend="nccl",
+            store=self._pg.store,
+            world_size=self.config.world_size,
+            rank=rank,
+            group_name=group_name,
+            device_id=torch.device(self.config.device),
+        )
+
+    def _transfer(
+        self,
+        tensors: Sequence[torch.Tensor],
+        send: bool,
+        peer: int,
+    ) -> None:
+        for t in tensors:
+            if not t.is_contiguous():
+                raise ValueError("AFD comm tensors must be contiguous")
+        # Batch the per-message tensors into one NCCL group so the transport
+        # sees a single transfer per logical message.

+def build_direct_deepep_lane_capacities(
+    token_buckets: Sequence[int],
+    num_lanes: int,
+    tokens_per_batch: int,

+    buckets = sorted(set(token_buckets))
+    max_tokens = buckets[-1]
+    if num_lanes == 1:
+        return (max_tokens,)
+
+    max_batch_size = max_tokens // tokens_per_batch
+    child_size, remainder = divmod(max_batch_size, num_lanes)
+    child_sizes = tuple(
+        child_size + (lane_id < remainder) for lane_id in range(num_lanes)

+    lane_capacities = [max_tokens]

+        required_tokens = child_batch_size * tokens_per_batch
+        lane_capacities.append(buckets[bisect.bisect_left(buckets, required_tokens)])

+            dispatch_output.hidden_states,
+            dispatch_output,
+            async_with_compute_stream=async_with_compute_stream,
+        )
+
+
+def build_afd_direct_deepep_adapters(
+    *,
+    comm: AFDCommBackend,
+    layers: Sequence[AFDMoELayer],
+    token_buckets: Sequence[int],
+    num_lanes: int,
+    tokens_per_batch: int,
+    dtype: torch.dtype,
+    comm_sm_budget: int | None,
+    nvfp4_input_scales: Sequence[float],
+    fp8_scale_ue8m0: bool | None,

+    if any(
+        (layer.hidden_size, layer.top_k, layer.num_experts) != schema
+        for layer in layers[1:]
+    ):

+        capability = torch.cuda.get_device_capability(torch.device(comm.config.device))

+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "AFD Direct DeepEP alignment below 128 requires SM100 or SM103 FFN"
+            )

+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "AFD Direct DeepEP NVFP4 scale count does not match MoE layers"
+        )
+
+    if comm.config.role is AFDRole.FFN:
+        from sglang.srt.layers.moe.ep_moe.layer import DeepEPMoE
+        from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.fp8 import Fp8MoEMethod
+        from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.modelopt_quant import (
+            ModelOptNvFp4FusedMoEMethod,
+        )
+
+        for layer in layers:
+            experts = layer.experts
+            quant_method = getattr(experts, "quant_method", None)
+            runner = getattr(quant_method, "runner", None)
+            runner_backend = getattr(runner, "runner_backend", None)

+                )
+            else:
+                valid_quant_core = (
+                    isinstance(quant_method, Fp8MoEMethod)
+                    and runner_backend is not None

+        layer.layer_id: torch.tensor(

+            dtype=torch.float32,

+        for layer, scale in zip(layers, nvfp4_input_scales)

+            comm=comm,
+            hidden_size=first.hidden_size,
+            top_k=first.top_k,
+            num_real_experts=first.num_experts,
+            num_max_dispatch_tokens_per_rank=int(capacity),
+            lane_id=lane_id,
+            num_lanes=num_lanes,
+            comm_sm_budget=comm_sm_budget,
+            component=component,
+            nvfp4_input_scales=nvfp4_scale_by_layer,
+            fp8_scale_ue8m0=fp8_scale_ue8m0,
+            expert_alignment=expert_alignment,
+            allow_hybrid_mode=allow_hybrid_mode,
