+"""Direct MegaMoE M2N decode data plane for AFD."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib
+import importlib.metadata
+import logging
+from collections.abc import Sequence
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.afd.afd_config import AFDRole, resolve_overlap_sm_partition
+from sglang.srt.afd.comm.base import AFDCommBackend
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from sglang.srt.afd.layers import AFDMoELayer
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+_COMPONENT_DISTRIBUTION = "sgl-deep-gemm"
+_COMPONENT_MODULE = "deep_gemm.mega.m2n"
+_PROCESS_GROUP_NAME = "afd_direct_megamoe_m2n"
+
+
+def _import_component() -> Any:
+    try:
+        return importlib.import_module(_COMPONENT_MODULE)
+    except ModuleNotFoundError as exc:
+        if exc.name not in (_COMPONENT_MODULE, "deep_gemm.mega", "deep_gemm"):
+            raise
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "--afd-backend direct_megamoe requires an sgl-deep-gemm build "
+            "with MegaMoE M2N support"
+        ) from exc
+
+
+def get_direct_megamoe_version() -> str:
+    _import_component()
+    try:
+        return importlib.metadata.version(_COMPONENT_DISTRIBUTION)
+    except importlib.metadata.PackageNotFoundError as exc:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "--afd-backend direct_megamoe requires the optional package "
+            f"{_COMPONENT_DISTRIBUTION!r}"
+        ) from exc
+
+
+def prepare_nvfp4_megamoe_weights(experts: torch.nn.Module) -> None:
+    from deep_gemm.mega import transform_weights_for_mega_moe
+    from deep_gemm.utils import transform_ue4m3_sf_into_required_layout
+
+    if not experts.quant_method.runner.runner_backend.is_flashinfer_cutedsl():
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "AFD Direct MegaMoE NVFP4 requires flashinfer_cutedsl for staged prefill"
+        )
+    if not torch.equal(experts.g1_alphas, experts.g1_alphas_up):
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "AFD NVFP4 staged prefill requires shared gate/up global scales"
+        )
+    w13_sf = transform_ue4m3_sf_into_required_layout(
+        experts.w13_weight_scale.data, experts.w13_weight.shape[1]
+    )
+    w2_sf = transform_ue4m3_sf_into_required_layout(
+        experts.w2_weight_scale.data, experts.w2_weight.shape[1]
+    )
+    # Prefill needs contiguous gate/up halves. Only W13 needs a second layout;
+    # W2 is shared, and the original scales remain available to CuteDSL.
+    experts.mega_l1_weights, experts.mega_l2_weights = transform_weights_for_mega_moe(
+        (experts.w13_weight.data.view(torch.int8), w13_sf),
+        (experts.w2_weight.data.view(torch.int8), w2_sf),
+        mma_type="nvfp4xnvfp4",
+    )
+    experts._mega_moe_weights_built = True
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class AFDDirectMegaMoEDispatchOutput:
+    lane_id: int
+    input_tokens: int
+    hidden_states: torch.Tensor
+
+
+class AFDDirectMegaMoEAdapter:
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        comm: AFDCommBackend,
+        layers: Sequence[AFDMoELayer],
+        num_max_tokens_per_rank: int,
+        num_lanes: int,
+        dtype: torch.dtype,
+        comm_sm_budget: int,
+        nvfp4_input_scales: Sequence[float],
+        component: Any,
+    ) -> None:
+        from sglang.srt.afd.comm.nccl import NCCLCommBackend
+
+        if not isinstance(comm, NCCLCommBackend):
+            raise TypeError("AFD Direct MegaMoE requires the NCCL backend")
+        if not layers:
+            raise RuntimeError("AFD Direct MegaMoE requires routed MoE layers")
+        if dtype != torch.bfloat16:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"AFD Direct MegaMoE requires BF16 activations, got {dtype}"
+            )
+        capability = torch.cuda.get_device_capability(torch.device(comm.config.device))
+        if capability not in ((10, 0), (10, 3)):
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "AFD Direct MegaMoE requires SM100 or SM103, "
+                f"got SM{capability[0]}{capability[1]}"
+            )
+        first = layers[0]
+        schema = (
+            first.hidden_size,
+            first.intermediate_size,
+            first.top_k,
+            first.num_experts,
+        )
+        if any(
+            (
+                layer.hidden_size,
+                layer.intermediate_size,
+                layer.top_k,
+                layer.num_experts,
+            )
+            != schema
+            for layer in layers[1:]
+        ):
+            raise RuntimeError("AFD Direct MegaMoE requires one shared MoE schema")
+        if any(layer.num_fused_shared_experts for layer in layers):
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "AFD Direct MegaMoE requires shared experts to remain on attn ranks"
+            )
+        if any(
+            layer.experts.moe_runner_config.activation != "silu"
+            or not layer.experts.moe_runner_config.is_gated
+            for layer in layers
+        ):
+            raise RuntimeError("AFD Direct MegaMoE requires SwiGLU experts")
+
+        self._role = comm.config.role
+        self._layers = tuple(layers)
+        self._component = component
+        self._comm = comm
+        self._max_tokens = int(num_max_tokens_per_rank)
+        self._num_lanes = int(num_lanes)
+        self._use_nvfp4 = bool(nvfp4_input_scales)
+        self._mma_type = "nvfp4xnvfp4" if self._use_nvfp4 else "fp8xfp4"
+        self._nvfp4_input_scales = (
+            {
+                layer.layer_id: torch.tensor(
+                    scale, dtype=torch.float32, device=comm.config.device
+                )
+                for layer, scale in zip(layers, nvfp4_input_scales, strict=True)
+            }
+            if self._use_nvfp4
+            else {}
+        )
+        total_num_sms = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(
+            comm.config.device
+        ).multi_processor_count
+        self._ag_num_sms = min(total_num_sms, comm_sm_budget) // self._num_lanes
+        if self._ag_num_sms <= 0:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "AFD Direct MegaMoE requires a positive AG SM budget per lane: "
+                f"budget={comm_sm_budget}, lanes={self._num_lanes}"
+            )
+        self.compute_num_sms_by_ag_lanes: tuple[int | None, ...] = (None,)
+        if self._role is AFDRole.ATTN:
+            # AG remains resident through EG and return reduction. Shared
+            # experts can overlap their own AG as well as the other lanes.
+            self.compute_num_sms_by_ag_lanes += tuple(
+                resolve_overlap_sm_partition(
+                    total_num_sms=total_num_sms,
+                    num_microbatches=self._num_lanes,
+                    overlap_sm_budget=ag_lanes * self._ag_num_sms,
+                )[0]
+                for ag_lanes in range(1, self._num_lanes + 1)
+            )
+        self._capture_start_barrier_pending = False
+        self._num_experts_per_rank = first.num_experts // comm.config.num_ffn_ranks
+        if self._num_experts_per_rank * comm.config.num_ffn_ranks != first.num_experts:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"AFD Direct MegaMoE cannot shard {first.num_experts} experts over "
+                f"{comm.config.num_ffn_ranks} ffn ranks"
+            )
+
+        group_rank = (
+            comm.config.attn_instance_rank_offset + comm.config.instance_rank
+            if self._role is AFDRole.ATTN
+            else comm.config.num_attn_ranks + comm.config.instance_rank
+        )
+        self._group = comm.create_process_group(
+            rank=group_rank,
+            group_name=_PROCESS_GROUP_NAME,
+        )
+        self._buffers = tuple(
+            component.get_symm_buffer_for_mega_moe_m2n(
+                self._group,
+                ag_size=comm.config.num_attn_ranks,
+                eg_size=comm.config.num_ffn_ranks,
+                num_experts=first.num_experts,
+                num_max_tokens_per_rank=self._max_tokens,
+                num_topk=first.top_k,
+                hidden=first.hidden_size,
+                intermediate_hidden=first.intermediate_size,
+                mma_type=self._mma_type,
+            )
+            for _ in range(self._num_lanes)
+        )
+
+        self._communication_streams: tuple[torch.cuda.Stream, ...] = ()
+        self._output_storage: tuple[torch.Tensor, ...] = ()
+        self._empty_hidden_states: torch.Tensor | None = None
+        self._empty_topk_ids: torch.Tensor | None = None
+        self._empty_topk_weights: torch.Tensor | None = None
+        self._output_scales = {
+            layer.layer_id: float(
+                1.0
+                if layer.routed_scaling_factor is None
+                else layer.routed_scaling_factor
+            )
+            for layer in layers
+        }
+        self._weight_descs: torch.Tensor | None = None
+        self._activation_clamp: float | None = None
+        self._l1_alphas: torch.Tensor | None = None
+        self._l2_alphas: torch.Tensor | None = None
+        self._l2_act_scales: torch.Tensor | None = None
+
+        if self._role is AFDRole.ATTN:
+            self._communication_streams = tuple(
+                torch.cuda.Stream(device=torch.device(comm.config.device))
+                for _ in range(self._num_lanes)
+            )
+            self._output_storage = tuple(
+                torch.empty(
+                    (max(self._max_tokens, 1), first.hidden_size),
+                    dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+                    device=comm.config.device,
+                )
+                for _ in range(self._num_lanes)
+            )
+            self._empty_hidden_states = torch.zeros(
+                (1, first.hidden_size), dtype=dtype, device=comm.config.device
+            )
+            self._empty_topk_ids = torch.full(
+                (1, first.top_k),
+                -1,
+                dtype=torch.int32,
+                device=comm.config.device,
+            )
+            self._empty_topk_weights = torch.zeros(
+                (1, first.top_k), dtype=torch.float32, device=comm.config.device
+            )
+        else:
+            self._build_ffn_state()
+
+        logger.info(
+            "AFD Direct MegaMoE ready: role=%s rank=%d/%d ag_ranks=%d "
+            "eg_ranks=%d layers=%d lanes=%d max_tokens=%d ag_sms_per_lane=%d",
+            self._role.value,
+            self._buffers[0].rank,
+            self._group.size(),
+            comm.config.num_attn_ranks,
+            comm.config.num_ffn_ranks,
+            len(self._layers),
+            self._num_lanes,
+            self._max_tokens,
+            self._ag_num_sms,
+        )
+
+    def arm_capture_start_barrier(self) -> None:
+        self._capture_start_barrier_pending = True
+
+    def _build_ffn_state(self) -> None:
+        from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.fp8 import Fp8MoEMethod
+        from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.modelopt_quant import (
+            ModelOptNvFp4FusedMoEMethod,
+        )
+
+        descriptors = []
+        activation_clamps = set()
+        weight_dtypes = set()
+        quant_method_type = (
+            ModelOptNvFp4FusedMoEMethod if self._use_nvfp4 else Fp8MoEMethod
+        )
+        for layer in self._layers:
+            experts = layer.experts
+            quant_method = getattr(experts, "quant_method", None)
+            if not isinstance(quant_method, quant_method_type) or not getattr(
+                experts, "_mega_moe_weights_built", False
+            ):
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    "AFD Direct MegaMoE requires prepared NVFP4, MXFP4 or "
+                    "128x128 block-wise FP8 weights"
+                )
+            if experts.num_local_experts != self._num_experts_per_rank:
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    "AFD Direct MegaMoE requires contiguous expert sharding: "
+                    f"local={experts.num_local_experts}, "
+                    f"expected={self._num_experts_per_rank}"
+                )
+            descriptors.append(
+                self._component.make_m2n_weight_descs(
+                    experts.mega_l1_weights,
+                    experts.mega_l2_weights,
+                    num_experts_per_rank=self._num_experts_per_rank,
+                    hidden=layer.hidden_size,
+                    intermediate_hidden=layer.intermediate_size,
+                    mma_type=self._mma_type,
+                )
+            )
+            activation_clamps.add(experts.moe_runner_config.swiglu_limit)
+            weight_dtypes.add(experts.w13_weight.dtype)
+
+        if len(weight_dtypes) != 1:
+            raise RuntimeError("AFD Direct MegaMoE requires one expert weight dtype")
+        self._use_fp8_weights = weight_dtypes.pop() == torch.float8_e4m3fn
+        if len(activation_clamps) != 1:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "AFD Direct MegaMoE requires one SwiGLU clamp across all layers"
+            )
+        self._activation_clamp = activation_clamps.pop()
+        self._weight_descs = torch.stack(descriptors).to(
+            device=self._buffers[0].buffer.device
+        )
+        if self._use_nvfp4:
+            self._l1_alphas = torch.stack(
+                [
+                    torch.stack(
+                        (layer.experts.g1_alphas, layer.experts.g1_alphas_up), dim=-1
+                    )
+                    for layer in self._layers
+                ]
+            ).contiguous()
+            self._l2_alphas = torch.stack(
+                [layer.experts.g2_alphas for layer in self._layers]
+            ).contiguous()
+            self._l2_act_scales = torch.stack(
+                [layer.experts.w2_input_scale_quant for layer in self._layers]
+            ).contiguous()
+
+    def dispatch(
+        self,
+        layer_id: int,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        topk_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        topk_weights: torch.Tensor,
+        *,
+        lane_id: int,
+        num_max_dispatch_tokens_per_rank: int,
+    ) -> AFDDirectMegaMoEDispatchOutput:
+        if self._role is not AFDRole.ATTN:
+            raise RuntimeError("AFD Direct MegaMoE dispatch requires an attn rank")
+        num_tokens = hidden_states.shape[0]
+        if not num_tokens <= num_max_dispatch_tokens_per_rank <= self._max_tokens:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "AFD Direct MegaMoE dispatch bucket is outside the allocated range: "
+                f"tokens={num_tokens}, bucket={num_max_dispatch_tokens_per_rank}, "
+                f"allocated={self._max_tokens}"
+            )
+        communication_stream = self._communication_streams[lane_id]
+        if num_tokens == 0:
+            assert self._empty_hidden_states is not None
+            assert self._empty_topk_ids is not None
+            assert self._empty_topk_weights is not None
+            # Send one unrouted sentinel row for collective participation
+            # while preserving an empty model output.
+            hidden_states = self._empty_hidden_states
+            topk_ids = self._empty_topk_ids
+            topk_weights = self._empty_topk_weights
+
+        hidden_states = hidden_states.contiguous()
+        topk_ids = topk_ids.contiguous()
+        topk_weights = topk_weights.float().contiguous()
+        output = self._output_storage[lane_id][: hidden_states.shape[0]]
+        current_stream = torch.cuda.current_stream(hidden_states.device)
+        communication_stream.wait_stream(current_stream)
+        hidden_states.record_stream(communication_stream)
+        topk_ids.record_stream(communication_stream)
+        topk_weights.record_stream(communication_stream)
+        if self._capture_start_barrier_pending:
+            self._comm.startup_barrier()
+            self._capture_start_barrier_pending = False
+        with torch.cuda.stream(communication_stream):
+            self._component.mega_moe_m2n_ag(
+                output,
+                hidden_states,
+                topk_ids,
+                topk_weights,
+                self._buffers[lane_id],
+                output_scale=self._output_scales[layer_id],
+                num_sms=self._ag_num_sms,
+                input_scale=self._nvfp4_input_scales.get(layer_id),
+            )
+        return AFDDirectMegaMoEDispatchOutput(
+            lane_id=lane_id,
+            input_tokens=num_tokens,
+            hidden_states=output[:num_tokens],
+        )
+
+    def combine(self, dispatch_output: AFDDirectMegaMoEDispatchOutput) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if self._role is not AFDRole.ATTN:
+            raise RuntimeError("AFD Direct MegaMoE combine requires an attn rank")
+        communication_stream = self._communication_streams[dispatch_output.lane_id]
+        torch.cuda.current_stream(dispatch_output.hidden_states.device).wait_stream(
+            communication_stream
+        )
+        return dispatch_output.hidden_states
+
+    def run_eg(self, wire_capacities: Sequence[int]) -> None:
+        if self._role is not AFDRole.FFN:
+            raise RuntimeError("AFD Direct MegaMoE EG requires an ffn rank")
+        assert self._weight_descs is not None
+        self._component.mega_moe_m2n_eg(
+            self._weight_descs,
+            self._buffers[: len(wire_capacities)],
+            expected_num_tokens_per_rank=max(wire_capacities),
+            num_experts_per_rank=self._num_experts_per_rank,
+            use_fp8_weights=self._use_fp8_weights,
+            activation_clamp=self._activation_clamp,
+            fast_math=True,
+            num_sms=0,
+            l1_alphas=self._l1_alphas,
+            l2_alphas=self._l2_alphas,
+            l2_act_scales=self._l2_act_scales,
+        )
+
+
+def build_afd_direct_megamoe_adapter(
+    *,
+    comm: AFDCommBackend,
+    layers: Sequence[AFDMoELayer],
+    token_buckets: Sequence[int],
+    num_lanes: int,
+    dtype: torch.dtype,
+    comm_sm_budget: int | None,
+    nvfp4_input_scales: Sequence[float],
+) -> AFDDirectMegaMoEAdapter:
+    if not token_buckets:
+        raise RuntimeError("AFD Direct MegaMoE requires decode token buckets")
+    if comm_sm_budget is None:
+        raise RuntimeError("AFD Direct MegaMoE requires a communication SM budget")
+    return AFDDirectMegaMoEAdapter(
+        comm=comm,
+        layers=layers,
+        num_max_tokens_per_rank=max(token_buckets),
+        num_lanes=num_lanes,
+        dtype=dtype,
+        comm_sm_budget=comm_sm_budget,
+        nvfp4_input_scales=nvfp4_input_scales,
+        component=_import_component(),

+def is_afd_fixed_shape_mode(forward_mode: ForwardMode) -> bool:
+    return forward_mode.is_decode() or forward_mode.is_target_verify()

+def build_decode_token_buckets(
+    local_batch_sizes: Sequence[int],
+    max_local_requests: int,
+    wire_token_multiplier: int,
+) -> list[int]:
+    """Convert A-side per-rank decode buckets to wire capacities."""
+    if max_local_requests <= 0 or wire_token_multiplier <= 0:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "AFD decode bucket bounds must be positive: "
+            f"max_local_requests={max_local_requests}, "
+            f"wire_token_multiplier={wire_token_multiplier}"
+        )
+    if any(batch_size <= 0 for batch_size in local_batch_sizes):
+        raise ValueError("AFD decode batch sizes must be positive")
+
+    local_buckets = {
+        batch_size
+        for batch_size in local_batch_sizes
+        if batch_size <= max_local_requests
+    }
+    # max_running_requests can exceed CUDA graph max_bs. Preserve the configured
+    # graph buckets, then add progressively coarser transport buckets instead of
+    # jumping directly to the largest slot.
+    last_bucket = max(local_buckets, default=0)
+    while last_bucket < max_local_requests:
+        if last_bucket < 16:
+            step = 1
+        elif last_bucket < 256:
+            step = 8
+        elif last_bucket < 512:
+            step = 16
+        else:
+            step = 32
+        last_bucket = min(
+            ((last_bucket // step) + 1) * step,
+            max_local_requests,
+        )
+        local_buckets.add(last_bucket)
+    local_buckets.add(max_local_requests)
+    return sorted(batch_size * wire_token_multiplier for batch_size in local_buckets)
+
+
+def select_token_bucket(token_buckets: Sequence[int], num_tokens: int) -> int:
+    if num_tokens == 0:
+        return 0
+    bucket_index = bisect.bisect_left(token_buckets, num_tokens)
+    if bucket_index == len(token_buckets):
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            f"AFD decode token count {num_tokens} exceeds transport capacity "
+            f"{token_buckets[-1]}"
+        )
+    return token_buckets[bucket_index]
+
+
+def split_afd_batch_size(batch_size: int, num_microbatches: int) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+    if num_microbatches < 2:
+        raise ValueError("AFD microbatch overlap requires at least two children")
+    if batch_size < num_microbatches:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "AFD parent batch size must be at least the number of microbatches: "
+            f"batch_size={batch_size}, microbatches={num_microbatches}"
+        )
+    child_size, remainder = divmod(batch_size, num_microbatches)
+    return tuple(
+        child_size + (child_index < remainder)
+        for child_index in range(num_microbatches)
+    )
+
+
+def afd_work_generation(step_id: int, work_index: int) -> int:
+    # Keep parent steps disjoint when the number of children changes.
+    return (step_id << 32) | (work_index + 1)

+class AFDFixedBufferPool:
+    """Fixed stream-ordered slots shared by layers with the same tensor schema."""

+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        layers: Sequence[AFDMoELayer],
+        token_buckets: Sequence[int],
+        dtype: torch.dtype,
+        device: torch.device,
+        role: str,
+        with_router_logits: bool,
+        num_slots: int,
+        decode_transport: Optional[NVSHMEMRuntimeOwner] = None,
+        with_response_scratch: bool = False,
+    ):
+        if num_slots <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("AFD fixed buffer pool requires at least one slot")
+        self._num_slots = num_slots
+        self._buckets = sorted(set(token_buckets))
+        if not self._buckets or self._buckets[0] <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("AFD fixed buffer pool requires positive token buckets")
+        self._bucket_set = set(self._buckets)
+
+        self._layer_keys = {
+            layer.layer_id: (layer.hidden_size, layer.top_k, layer.num_experts)
+            for layer in layers
+        }
+        if len(self._layer_keys) != len(layers):
+            raise RuntimeError("AFD found duplicate MoE layer ids")
+
+        max_tokens = self._buckets[-1]
+        self._decode_transport = decode_transport
+        self._buffers: dict[tuple[int, int, int, int], _SlotBuffers] = {}
+        self._router_logits: dict[tuple[int, int, int, int], torch.Tensor] = {}
+        schemas = sorted(set(self._layer_keys.values()))
+        if decode_transport is None:
+            for slot_id in range(num_slots):
+                for hidden_size, top_k, num_experts in schemas:
+                    key = (slot_id, hidden_size, top_k, num_experts)
+                    self._buffers[key] = _SlotBuffers(
+                        hidden_states=torch.empty(
+                            (max_tokens, hidden_size), dtype=dtype, device=device
+                        ),
+                        topk_ids=torch.empty(
+                            (max_tokens, top_k), dtype=torch.int32, device=device
+                        ),
+                        topk_weights=torch.empty(
+                            (max_tokens, top_k), dtype=torch.float32, device=device
+                        ),
+                        output=torch.empty(
+                            (max_tokens, hidden_size), dtype=dtype, device=device
+                        ),
+                        router_logits=(
+                            torch.empty(
+                                (max_tokens, num_experts),
+                                dtype=torch.float32,
+                                device=device,
+                            )
+                            if with_router_logits
+                            else None
+                        ),
+                        response_scratch=(
+                            torch.empty(
+                                (max_tokens, hidden_size),
+                                dtype=dtype,
+                                device=device,
+                            )
+                            if with_response_scratch
+                            else None
+                        ),
+                    )
+        elif with_router_logits:
+            for slot_id in range(num_slots):
+                for hidden_size, top_k, num_experts in schemas:
+                    key = (slot_id, hidden_size, top_k, num_experts)
+                    self._router_logits[key] = torch.empty(
+                        (max_tokens, num_experts),
+                        dtype=torch.float32,
+                        device=device,
+                    )
+
+        self._active_generations: list[Optional[int]] = [None] * num_slots
+        allocated_bytes = sum(
+            tensor.numel() * tensor.element_size()
+            for buffers in self._buffers.values()
+            for tensor in (
+                buffers.hidden_states,
+                buffers.topk_ids,
+                buffers.topk_weights,
+                buffers.output,
+                buffers.router_logits,
+                buffers.response_scratch,
+            )
+            if tensor is not None
+        ) + sum(
+            tensor.numel() * tensor.element_size()
+            for tensor in self._router_logits.values()
+        )
+        logger.info(
+            "AFD fixed buffer pool ready: role=%s slots=%d schemas=%d buckets=%d "
+            "max_tokens=%d memory=%.2f MiB",
+            role,
+            num_slots,
+            len(schemas),
+            len(self._buckets),
+            max_tokens,
+            allocated_bytes / (1024 * 1024),
+        )
+
+    def acquire(
+        self,
+        slot_id: int,
+        layer_id: int,
+        generation: int,
+        capacity: int,
+        input_tokens: int,
+    ) -> AFDWorkHandle:
+        if not 0 <= slot_id < self._num_slots:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"AFD fixed buffer has no slot {slot_id}")
+        active_generation = self._active_generations[slot_id]
+        if active_generation is not None:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"AFD fixed buffer slot {slot_id} is still active: "
+                f"generation={active_generation}"
+            )
+        if input_tokens > capacity:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"AFD input token count {input_tokens} exceeds capacity {capacity}"
+            )
+        if layer_id not in self._layer_keys:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"AFD fixed buffer has no layer {layer_id}")
+        if capacity not in self._bucket_set:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"AFD capacity {capacity} is not a configured fixed-buffer bucket"
+            )
+        layer_key = self._layer_keys[layer_id]
+        buffer_key = (slot_id, *layer_key)
+        if self._decode_transport is None:
+            buffers = self._buffers[buffer_key]
+            hidden_states = buffers.hidden_states[:capacity]
+            topk_ids = buffers.topk_ids[:capacity]
+            topk_weights = buffers.topk_weights[:capacity]
+            output = buffers.output[:capacity]
+            router_logits = (
+                buffers.router_logits[:capacity]
+                if buffers.router_logits is not None
+                else None
+            )
+            response_scratch = (
+                buffers.response_scratch[:capacity]
+                if buffers.response_scratch is not None
+                else None
+            )
+        else:
+            views = self._decode_transport.decode_views(
+                layer_id,
+                capacity,
+                slot_id=slot_id,
+            )
+            hidden_states = views.hidden_states
+            topk_ids = views.topk_ids
+            topk_weights = views.topk_weights
+            output = views.output
+            router_logits_buffer = self._router_logits.get(buffer_key)
+            router_logits = (
+                router_logits_buffer[:capacity]
+                if router_logits_buffer is not None
+                else None
+            )
+            response_scratch = None
+        self._active_generations[slot_id] = generation
+        return AFDWorkHandle(
+            slot_id=slot_id,
+            generation=generation,
+            capacity=capacity,
+            input_tokens=input_tokens,
+            hidden_states=hidden_states,
+            topk_ids=topk_ids,
+            topk_weights=topk_weights,
+            output=output,
+            router_logits=router_logits,
+            response_scratch=response_scratch,
+        )
+
+    def release(self, handle: AFDWorkHandle) -> None:
+        slot_id = handle.slot_id
+        if slot_id is None or not 0 <= slot_id < self._num_slots:
+            raise RuntimeError("AFD attempted to release an invalid slot handle")
+        active_generation = self._active_generations[slot_id]
+        if active_generation != handle.generation:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "AFD fixed buffer generation mismatch: "
+                f"slot={slot_id}, active={active_generation}, "
+                f"handle={handle.generation}"
+            )
+        self._active_generations[slot_id] = None

+        num_buffer_slots = self._nccl_overlap_depth
+        self._buffer_slots: list[dict[tuple[int, int, int], _CohortBuffers]] = []

+        self._layers = compute.layers
+        self._tp_group = scheduler.tp_group
+        self._device_module = scheduler.device_module
+        self._rank = self._comm.config.instance_rank
+        self._num_ranks = self._comm.config.num_ffn_ranks
+        self._scattered = get_disagg().afd_ffn_moe_backend == "deepep"
+        direct_deepep = handshake.local.afd_backend == "direct_deepep"
+        direct_megamoe = handshake.local.afd_backend == "direct_megamoe"

+            self._rank,

+        self._decode_step_graph: _AFDFFNDecodeStepGraph | None = None
+        self._decode_num_microbatches = handshake.peer.decode_num_microbatches
+        self._cohort_graph_child_plans: frozenset[tuple[int, ...]] = frozenset()

+            torch.cuda.Stream(device=self._device)

+        )
+        self._request_ready = [
+            torch.cuda.Event()
+            for _ in range(self._decode_num_microbatches if staged_overlap else 0)

+        self._response_ready = [
+            torch.cuda.Event()
+            for _ in range(self._decode_num_microbatches if staged_overlap else 0)

+
+        if compute.device != self._device:

+                f"AFD ffn compute device {compute.device} does not match "
+                f"communication device {self._device}"

+        if (
+            self._tp_group.world_size != self._num_ranks
+            or self._tp_group.rank_in_group != self._rank
+        ):

+                "AFD ffn rank topology does not match the local TP group: "
+                f"comm={self._rank}/{self._num_ranks}, "
+                f"tp_group={self._tp_group.rank_in_group}/"
+                f"{self._tp_group.world_size}"
+            )
+
+        self._direct_deepep_lanes = ()
+        self._direct_megamoe = None
+        if direct_deepep:
+            from sglang.srt.afd.direct_deepep import (
+                build_afd_direct_deepep_adapters,
+            )
+
+            self._direct_deepep_lanes = build_afd_direct_deepep_adapters(
+                comm=comm,
+                layers=self._layers,
+                token_buckets=handshake.peer.decode_token_buckets,
+                num_lanes=self._decode_num_microbatches,
+                tokens_per_batch=handshake.peer.decode_num_tokens_per_bs,
+                dtype=self._dtype,
+                comm_sm_budget=handshake.local.afd_comm_sm_budget,
+                nvfp4_input_scales=handshake.local.direct_nvfp4_input_scales,
+                fp8_scale_ue8m0=handshake.local.direct_deepep_fp8_scale_ue8m0,
+                expert_alignment=handshake.local.direct_deepep_expert_alignment,
+                allow_hybrid_mode=handshake.local.direct_deepep_allow_hybrid,
+            )
+        elif direct_megamoe:
+            from sglang.srt.afd.direct_megamoe import (
+                build_afd_direct_megamoe_adapter,
+            )
+
+            self._direct_megamoe = build_afd_direct_megamoe_adapter(
+                comm=comm,
+                layers=self._layers,
+                token_buckets=handshake.peer.decode_token_buckets,
+                num_lanes=self._decode_num_microbatches,
+                dtype=self._dtype,
+                comm_sm_budget=handshake.local.afd_comm_sm_budget,
+                nvfp4_input_scales=handshake.local.direct_nvfp4_input_scales,

+        if self._decode_num_microbatches > 1 and not direct_megamoe:
+            overlap_sm_budget = handshake.local.afd_comm_sm_budget
+            assert overlap_sm_budget is not None
+            total_num_sms = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(
+                self._device
+            ).multi_processor_count
+            (
+                self._compute_num_sms,
+                communication_num_sms,
+            ) = resolve_overlap_sm_partition(
+                total_num_sms=total_num_sms,
+                num_microbatches=self._decode_num_microbatches,
+                overlap_sm_budget=overlap_sm_budget,

+            if self._rank == 0:

+                    "AFD ffn overlap SM partition: backend=%s compute=%d "

+        self._decode_edge_token_buckets = tuple(handshake.peer.decode_token_buckets)
+        decode_token_buckets = self._decode_edge_token_buckets
+        if self._scattered:
+            source_count = max(len(self._attn_ranks), 1)

+                capacity * source_count for capacity in decode_token_buckets
+            ]
+            max_source_count = (
+                self._comm.config.num_attn_ranks + self._num_ranks - 1
+            ) // self._num_ranks

+        if self._decode_transport is None:

+        self._decode_pool = (
+            None
+            if self._direct_deepep_lanes or self._direct_megamoe is not None
+            else AFDFixedBufferPool(
+                layers=self._layers,
+                token_buckets=decode_pool_token_buckets,
+                dtype=self._dtype,
+                device=self._device,
+                role="ffn",
+                with_router_logits=True,
+                num_slots=self._decode_num_microbatches,
+                decode_transport=decode_pool_transport,
+            )
+        )

+        logger.info(
+            "AFD ffn executor ready: session=%d rank=%d/%d moe_layers=%d "
+            "first_layer=%d last_layer=%d device=%s dtype=%s",
+            self._session_id,
+            self._rank,
+            self._num_ranks,
+            len(self._layers),
+            self._layers[0].layer_id,
+            self._layers[-1].layer_id,
+            self._device,
+            self._dtype,
