+    def capture_communication_graphs(
+        self,
+        plan: AFDGraphCapturePlan,
+    ) -> None:
+        self._cohort_graph_child_plans = frozenset(
+            tuple(variant.child_wire_capacities) for variant in plan.attn_graph_variants
+        )
+        if not plan.enabled:
+            return
+        if self._direct_megamoe is not None:
+            self._capture_direct_megamoe_graphs(plan)
+            return
+        if self._direct_deepep_lanes:
+            self._capture_direct_deepep_graphs(plan)
+            return
+
+        ffn_variants = dict(plan.ffn_graph_variants)
+        attn_phase: list[tuple[tuple[int, ...], tuple[int, ...] | None]] = []
+        for variant in plan.attn_graph_variants:
+            compute_capacities = (
+                None
+                if None in variant.child_compute_capacities
+                else tuple(
+                    capacity
+                    for capacity in variant.child_compute_capacities
+                    if capacity is not None
+                )
+            )
+            attn_phase.append(
+                (
+                    tuple(variant.child_wire_capacities),
+                    compute_capacities,
+                )
+            )
+
+        graph_compute_capacities = [
+            capacity
+            for _, compute_capacities in attn_phase
+            if compute_capacities is not None
+            for capacity in compute_capacities
+        ]
+        graph_compute_capacities.extend(ffn_variants.values())
+        if self._rank == 0:
+            logger.info(
+                "Capture AFD ffn communication graphs begin: "
+                "attn_variants=%s wire_to_compute=%s",
+                [
+                    (
+                        variant.attn_batch_size,
+                        variant.child_wire_capacities,
+                        variant.child_compute_capacities,
+                    )
+                    for variant in plan.attn_graph_variants
+                ],
+                list(plan.ffn_graph_variants),
+            )
+        if graph_compute_capacities:
+            self._compute._prepare_graph_capture(max(graph_compute_capacities))
+            self._decode_step_graph = _AFDFFNDecodeStepGraph(
+                self._compute,
+                self._run_integrated_graph_step,
+            )
+
+        temporary_graphs: list[torch.cuda.CUDAGraph] = []
+        self._comm.startup_barrier()
+        temporary_graphs.extend(self._capture_variants(attn_phase))
+        self._comm.startup_barrier()
+
+        full_steps = sum(
+            compute_capacities is not None for _, compute_capacities in attn_phase
+        )
+
+        if self._decode_transport is None:
+            logger.info(
+                "AFD ffn communication graphs ready: full_steps=%d attn_participants=0",
+                full_steps,
+            )
+            return
+
+        attn_capacities = {
+            wire_capacities[0]
+            for wire_capacities, _ in attn_phase
+            if len(wire_capacities) == 1
+        }
+        ffn_only_phase = [
+            ((wire_capacity,), (compute_capacity,))
+            for wire_capacity, compute_capacity in plan.ffn_graph_variants
+            if wire_capacity not in attn_capacities
+        ]
+        temporary_graphs.extend(self._capture_variants(ffn_only_phase))
+        full_steps += len(ffn_only_phase)
+        self._comm.startup_barrier()
+
+        helper = self._capture_wait_helper()
+        self._decode_transport.install_wait_helper(helper)
+        self._comm.startup_barrier()
+
+        logger.info(
+            "AFD ffn communication graphs ready: full_steps=%d attn_participants=%d",
+            full_steps,
+            len(temporary_graphs),
+        )
+
+    def _capture_direct_deepep_graphs(
+        self,
+        plan: AFDGraphCapturePlan,
+    ) -> None:
+        variants = [
+            (variant.child_wire_capacities, ()) for variant in plan.attn_graph_variants
+        ]
+
+        if self._rank == 0:
+            logger.info(
+                "Capture AFD Direct DeepEP graphs begin: wire_capacities=%s",
+                [wire_capacities for wire_capacities, _ in variants],
+            )
+        self._decode_step_graph = _AFDFFNDecodeStepGraph(
+            self._compute,
+            self._run_direct_deepep_graph_step,
+            direct_data_plane=True,
+        )
+        self._comm.startup_barrier()
+        # A reaches this barrier at its first MoE after local graph warmup.
+        self._comm.startup_barrier()
+        self._capture_variants(variants)
+        self._comm.startup_barrier()
+        if self._rank == 0:
+            logger.info(
+                "AFD Direct DeepEP graphs ready: full_steps=%d",
+                len(variants),
+            )
+
+    def _capture_direct_megamoe_graphs(
+        self,
+        plan: AFDGraphCapturePlan,
+    ) -> None:
+        variants = [
+            (variant.child_wire_capacities, ()) for variant in plan.attn_graph_variants
+        ]
+        if self._rank == 0:
+            logger.info(
+                "Capture AFD Direct MegaMoE graphs begin: wire_capacities=%s",
+                [wire_capacities for wire_capacities, _ in variants],
+            )
+        self._decode_step_graph = _AFDFFNDecodeStepGraph(
+            self._compute,
+            self._run_direct_megamoe_graph_step,
+            direct_data_plane=True,
+        )
+        self._comm.startup_barrier()
+        # A joins here at the first routed layer after local graph warmup.
+        self._comm.startup_barrier()
+        self._capture_variants(variants)
+        self._comm.startup_barrier()
+        if self._rank == 0:
+            logger.info(
+                "AFD Direct MegaMoE graphs ready: full_steps=%d",
+                len(variants),
+            )
+
+    def _decode_source_segments(
+        self, edge_wire_capacity: int
+    ) -> tuple[_SourceSegment, ...]:
+        return _prepare_source_segments(
+            (
+                self._comm.config.attn_global_rank(attn_rank),
+                edge_wire_capacity,
+            )
+            for attn_rank in self._attn_ranks
+        )
+
+    def _prepare_decode_children(
+        self, msg: AFDSyncMsg
+    ) -> tuple[_PreparedDecodeChild, ...]:
+        forward_mode = ForwardMode(msg.forward_mode)
+        if not is_afd_fixed_shape_mode(forward_mode):
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "AFD fixed-shape children require DECODE or TARGET_VERIFY"
+            )
+        child_wire_capacities = msg.effective_child_wire_capacities
+        num_children = len(child_wire_capacities)
+        if msg.child_wire_capacities and num_children != self._decode_num_microbatches:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "AFD child plan does not match the configured microbatch count: "
+                f"children={num_children}, "
+                f"configured={self._decode_num_microbatches}"
+            )
+        children = self._prepare_decode_children_for_capacities(child_wire_capacities)
+        if msg.child_wire_capacities and (
+            sum(child_wire_capacities) != msg.wire_capacity
+        ):
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "AFD child capacities do not match the parent wire "
+                f"capacity: children={child_wire_capacities}, "
+                f"parent={msg.wire_capacity}"
+            )
+        dp_capacity = self._dp_capacity(msg)
+        local_wire_capacity = sum(child.local_wire_capacity for child in children)
+        if dp_capacity > local_wire_capacity:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"AFD DP capacity {dp_capacity} exceeds local wire capacity "
+                f"{local_wire_capacity}"
+            )
+        return children
+
+    def _prepare_decode_children_for_capacities(
+        self,
+        child_wire_capacities: tuple[int, ...],
+    ) -> tuple[_PreparedDecodeChild, ...]:
+        num_children = len(child_wire_capacities)
+        if num_children not in (1, self._decode_num_microbatches):
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "AFD decode child count must be one or the configured "
+                f"microbatch count {self._decode_num_microbatches}, got "
+                f"{num_children}"
+            )
+        if any(capacity <= 0 for capacity in child_wire_capacities):
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"AFD decode child capacities must be positive: {child_wire_capacities}"
+            )
+        return tuple(
+            self._prepare_decode_child(wire_capacity, slot_id)
+            for slot_id, wire_capacity in enumerate(child_wire_capacities)
+        )
+
+    def _prepare_decode_child(
+        self, edge_wire_capacity: int, slot_id: int = 0
+    ) -> _PreparedDecodeChild:
+        if edge_wire_capacity not in self._decode_edge_token_buckets:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "AFD wire capacity is not a negotiated decode bucket: "
+                f"{edge_wire_capacity}"
+            )
+        source_segments = self._decode_source_segments(edge_wire_capacity)
+        source_count = len(source_segments)
+        return _PreparedDecodeChild(
+            slot_id=slot_id,
+            source_segments=source_segments,
+            local_wire_capacity=sum(segment.capacity for segment in source_segments),
+            staging_capacity=max(source_count, 1) * edge_wire_capacity,
+        )
+
+    def _can_run_cohort(self, msg: AFDSyncMsg) -> bool:
+        if not is_afd_fixed_shape_mode(ForwardMode(msg.forward_mode)) or not sum(
+            msg.tokens_per_rank
+        ):
+            return False
+        if msg.communication_graph and self._decode_transport is None:
+            return False
+        if not msg.child_wire_capacities:
+            return True
+        return (
+            self._decode_num_microbatches > 1
+            and len(msg.child_wire_capacities) == self._decode_num_microbatches
+        )
+
+    def _recv_source_inputs(
+        self,
+        source_segments: tuple[_SourceSegment, ...],
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        topk_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        topk_weights: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> None:
+        for peer_global_rank, capacity, rows in source_segments:
+            if capacity > 0:
+                self._comm.recv_from(
+                    [hidden_states[rows], topk_ids[rows], topk_weights[rows]],
+                    peer_global_rank,
+                )
+
+    def _copy_decode_inputs(
+        self,
+        layer_id: int,
+        source_segments: tuple[_SourceSegment, ...],
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        topk_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        topk_weights: torch.Tensor,
+        *,
+        slot_id: int = 0,
+    ) -> None:
+        for peer_global_rank, capacity, rows in source_segments:
+            views = self._decode_transport.decode_views(
+                layer_id,
+                capacity,
+                slot_id=slot_id,
+                peer_global_rank=peer_global_rank,
+            )
+            hidden_states[rows].copy_(views.hidden_states)
+            topk_ids[rows].copy_(views.topk_ids)
+            topk_weights[rows].copy_(views.topk_weights)
+
+    def _recv_decode_child(
+        self,
+        layer_id: int,
+        child: _PreparedDecodeChild,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        topk_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        topk_weights: torch.Tensor,
+        *,
+        capture_transport: bool = False,
+    ) -> None:
+        transport = self._decode_transport
+        if transport is not None:
+            if capture_transport or child.slot_id != 0:
+                transport.launch_wait_request(slot_id=child.slot_id)
+            else:
+                transport.wait_request()
+            self._copy_decode_inputs(
+                layer_id,
+                child.source_segments,
+                hidden_states,
+                topk_ids,
+                topk_weights,
+                slot_id=child.slot_id,
+            )
+            return
+
+        self._recv_source_inputs(
+            child.source_segments, hidden_states, topk_ids, topk_weights
+        )
+
+    def _send_decode_child(
+        self,
+        layer_id: int,
+        child: _PreparedDecodeChild,
+        output: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> None:
+        transport = self._decode_transport
+        if transport is not None:
+            for peer_global_rank, capacity, rows in child.source_segments:
+                views = transport.decode_views(
+                    layer_id,
+                    capacity,
+                    slot_id=child.slot_id,
+                    peer_global_rank=peer_global_rank,
+                )
+                views.output.copy_(output[rows])
+                transport.put_response(
+                    layer_id,
+                    capacity,
+                    slot_id=child.slot_id,
+                    peer_global_rank=peer_global_rank,
+                )
+            return
+
+        for peer_global_rank, capacity, rows in child.source_segments:
+            self._comm.send_to(
+                [output[rows].contiguous()],
+                peer_global_rank,
+            )
+
+    def _run_integrated_graph_step(
+        self,
+        wire_capacities: tuple[int, ...],
+        compute_capacities: tuple[int, ...],
+    ) -> None:
+        if len(wire_capacities) > 1:
+            children = self._prepare_decode_children_for_capacities(wire_capacities)
+            self._run_overlap_step(
+                step_id=0,
+                children=children,
+                child_compute_capacities=compute_capacities,
+            )
+            return
+
+        edge_wire_capacity = wire_capacities[0]
+        compute_capacity = compute_capacities[0]
+        source_segments = self._decode_source_segments(edge_wire_capacity)
+        source_count = len(source_segments)
+        wire_capacity = source_count * edge_wire_capacity
+        staging_capacity = max(source_count, 1) * edge_wire_capacity
+        direct_nccl_io = (
+            self._decode_transport is None
+            and source_count == 1
+            and wire_capacity <= compute_capacity
+        )
+        work_capacity = compute_capacity if direct_nccl_io else staging_capacity
+        for layer_index, layer in enumerate(self._layers):
+            work = self._decode_pool.acquire(
+                slot_id=0,
+                layer_id=layer.layer_id,
+                generation=afd_work_generation(0, layer_index),
+                capacity=work_capacity,
+                input_tokens=wire_capacity,
+            )
+            if self._decode_transport is not None:
+                self._decode_transport.launch_wait_request()
+                if source_count > 1:
+                    self._copy_decode_inputs(
+                        layer.layer_id,
+                        source_segments,
+                        work.hidden_states,
+                        work.topk_ids,
+                        work.topk_weights,
+                        slot_id=0,
+                    )
+            else:
+                self._recv_source_inputs(
+                    source_segments,
+                    work.hidden_states,
+                    work.topk_ids,
+                    work.topk_weights,
+                )
+            input_capacity = compute_capacity if direct_nccl_io else wire_capacity
+            output = self._compute.run_integrated_layer(
+                layer_index,
+                work.hidden_states[:input_capacity],
+                work.topk_ids[:input_capacity],
+                work.topk_weights[:input_capacity],
+                wire_capacity,
+                compute_capacity,
+                stage_inputs=not direct_nccl_io,
+            )
+            if self._decode_transport is not None:
+                if source_count == 1:
+                    peer_global_rank, capacity, _ = source_segments[0]
+                    work.output.copy_(output[:capacity])
+                    self._decode_transport.put_response(
+                        layer.layer_id,
+                        capacity,
+                        peer_global_rank=peer_global_rank,
+                    )
+                elif source_segments:
+                    for peer_global_rank, capacity, rows in source_segments:
+                        views = self._decode_transport.decode_views(
+                            layer.layer_id,
+                            capacity,
+                            peer_global_rank=peer_global_rank,
+                        )
+                        views.output.copy_(output[rows])
+                        self._decode_transport.put_response(
+                            layer.layer_id,
+                            capacity,
+                            peer_global_rank=peer_global_rank,
+                        )
+            else:
+                if direct_nccl_io and output.is_contiguous():
+                    peer_global_rank, capacity, _ = source_segments[0]
+                    self._comm.send_to(
+                        [output[:capacity]],
+                        peer_global_rank,
+                    )
+                    self._decode_pool.release(work)
+                    continue
+                work.output[:wire_capacity].copy_(output[:wire_capacity])
+                for peer_global_rank, capacity, rows in source_segments:
+                    self._comm.send_to(
+                        [work.output[rows]],
+                        peer_global_rank,
+                    )
+            self._decode_pool.release(work)
+
+    def _capture_variants(
+        self,
+        variants: list[tuple[tuple[int, ...], tuple[int, ...] | None]],
+    ) -> list[torch.cuda.CUDAGraph]:
+        if not variants:
+            return []
+
+        temporary_graphs: list[torch.cuda.CUDAGraph] = []
+        graph_session = (
+            self._decode_step_graph.capture_session
+            if self._decode_step_graph is not None
+            else None
+        )
+        with (
+            torch.inference_mode(),
+            model_capture_mode(),
+            freeze_gc(self._compute.enable_cudagraph_gc),
+            graph_capture() as ctx,
+        ):
+            session = (
+                graph_session(ctx.stream)
+                if graph_session is not None
+                else nullcontext()
+            )
+            with session:
+                for wire_capacities, compute_capacities in variants:
+                    if compute_capacities is None:
+                        (wire_capacity,) = wire_capacities
+                        temporary_graphs.append(
+                            self._capture_wait_participant(
+                                wire_capacity,
+                                ctx.stream,
+                            )
+                        )
+                    else:
+                        assert self._decode_step_graph is not None
+                        self._decode_step_graph.capture_variant(
+                            wire_capacities,
+                            compute_capacities,
+                        )
+
+        self._device_module.synchronize()
+        self._tp_group.barrier()
+        return temporary_graphs
+
+    def _capture_wait_participant(
+        self,
+        wire_capacity: int,
+        stream: torch.cuda.Stream,
+    ) -> torch.cuda.CUDAGraph:
+        set_is_extend_in_batch(False)
+        for _ in range(2):
+            self._device_module.synchronize()
+            self._tp_group.barrier()
+            self._run_nvshmem_eager_step(
+                step_id=0,
+                source_segments=self._decode_source_segments(wire_capacity),
+            )
+        assert self._decode_transport is not None
+        return self._decode_transport.capture_wait_graph(
+            len(self._layers),
+            stream,
+        )
+
+    def _capture_wait_helper(self) -> torch.cuda.CUDAGraph:
+        assert self._decode_transport is not None
+        with graph_capture() as ctx:
+            helper = self._decode_transport.capture_wait_graph(1, ctx.stream)
+        self._device_module.synchronize()
+        self._tp_group.barrier()
+        return helper
+
+    def run_step(self, msg: AFDSyncMsg) -> None:
+        dp_capacity = self._dp_capacity(msg)
+        total_tokens = sum(msg.tokens_per_rank)
+        forward_mode = ForwardMode(msg.forward_mode)
+        if forward_mode.is_idle():
+            if total_tokens != 0 or msg.wire_capacity != 0:
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    "AFD idle step must have zero capacity: "
+                    f"tokens={total_tokens}, wire={msg.wire_capacity}"
+                )
+            return
+        if total_tokens == 0:
+            if msg.wire_capacity != 0:
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    f"AFD idle step has nonzero wire capacity {msg.wire_capacity}"
+                )
+            return
+        fixed_shape = is_afd_fixed_shape_mode(forward_mode)
+        if msg.child_wire_capacities and not fixed_shape:
+            raise RuntimeError("AFD child plan requires DECODE or TARGET_VERIFY")
+
+        if self._direct_megamoe is not None and fixed_shape:
+            child_wire_capacities = msg.effective_child_wire_capacities
+            if msg.child_wire_capacities and (
+                len(child_wire_capacities) != self._decode_num_microbatches
+                or sum(child_wire_capacities) != msg.wire_capacity
+            ):
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    "AFD Direct MegaMoE child plan does not match the "
+                    f"configured parent: children={child_wire_capacities}, "
+                    f"configured={self._decode_num_microbatches}, "
+                    f"parent={msg.wire_capacity}"
+                )
+            with torch.inference_mode():
+                if (
+                    msg.communication_graph
+                    and self._decode_step_graph is not None
+                    and self._decode_step_graph.replay(child_wire_capacities)
+                ):
+                    return
+                if msg.communication_graph:
+                    raise RuntimeError(
+                        "AFD ffn has no Direct MegaMoE graph for wire capacity "
+                        f"{msg.wire_capacity}"
+                    )
+                self._run_direct_megamoe_step(child_wire_capacities)
+            return
+
+        if self._direct_deepep_lanes and fixed_shape:
+            child_wire_capacities = msg.effective_child_wire_capacities
+            if msg.child_wire_capacities:
+                if len(child_wire_capacities) != self._decode_num_microbatches:
+                    raise RuntimeError(
+                        "AFD Direct DeepEP child count does not match the "
+                        "configured microbatch count: "
+                        f"children={len(child_wire_capacities)}, "
+                        f"configured={self._decode_num_microbatches}"
+                    )
+                if sum(child_wire_capacities) != msg.wire_capacity:
+                    raise RuntimeError(
+                        "AFD Direct DeepEP child capacities do not match the "
+                        f"parent: children={child_wire_capacities}, "
+                        f"parent={msg.wire_capacity}"
+                    )
+            with torch.inference_mode():
+                if (
+                    msg.communication_graph
+                    and self._decode_step_graph is not None
+                    and self._decode_step_graph.replay(child_wire_capacities)
+                ):
+                    return
+                if msg.communication_graph:
+                    raise RuntimeError(
+                        "AFD ffn has no Direct DeepEP graph for child wire "
+                        f"capacities {child_wire_capacities}"
+                    )
+                self._run_direct_deepep_step(
+                    child_wire_capacities,
+                    do_cpu_sync=len(child_wire_capacities) == 1,
+                )
+            return
+
+        decode_children = self._prepare_decode_children(msg) if fixed_shape else ()
+        source_segments = (
+            decode_children[0].source_segments
+            if len(decode_children) == 1
+            else _prepare_source_segments(
+                (
+                    self._comm.config.attn_global_rank(attn_rank),
+                    (
+                        msg.wire_capacity
+                        if not self._scattered
+                        else msg.tokens_per_rank[attn_rank]
+                    ),
+                )
+                for attn_rank in self._attn_ranks
+            )
+        )
+        wire_capacity = (
+            sum(child.local_wire_capacity for child in decode_children)
+            if decode_children
+            else sum(segment.capacity for segment in source_segments)
+        )
+        # Fixed-shape F execution is phase-neutral; capacity alone selects the
+        # paired graph for both FULL and SCATTERED layouts.
+        set_is_extend_in_batch(forward_mode.is_extend() and not fixed_shape)
+        if fixed_shape:
+            if dp_capacity > wire_capacity:
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    f"AFD DP capacity {dp_capacity} exceeds wire capacity "
+                    f"{wire_capacity}"
+                )
+        elif wire_capacity != dp_capacity:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "AFD prefill requires exact-size transport: "
+                f"dp={dp_capacity}, wire={wire_capacity}"
+            )
+
+        if len(decode_children) > 1:
+            child_wire_capacities = msg.effective_child_wire_capacities
+            with torch.inference_mode():
+                if msg.communication_graph:
+                    if (
+                        self._decode_step_graph is not None
+                        and self._decode_step_graph.replay(child_wire_capacities)
+                    ):
+                        return
+                    raise RuntimeError(
+                        "AFD ffn has no microbatch communication graph for child "
+                        f"wire capacities {child_wire_capacities}"
+                    )
+                self._run_overlap_step(msg.step_id, decode_children)
+            return
+
+        if fixed_shape and (
+            msg.communication_graph or self._decode_transport is not None
+        ):
+            with torch.inference_mode():
+                if (
+                    self._decode_step_graph is not None
+                    and self._decode_step_graph.replay((msg.wire_capacity,))
+                ):
+                    return
+                if self._decode_transport is None:
+                    raise RuntimeError(
+                        "AFD ffn has no communication graph for wire capacity "
+                        f"{msg.wire_capacity}"
+                    )
+
+        if fixed_shape and self._decode_transport is not None:
+            with torch.inference_mode():
+                self._run_nvshmem_eager_step(
+                    step_id=msg.step_id,
+                    source_segments=source_segments,
+                )
+            return
+
+        with torch.inference_mode():
+            self._run_eager_step(
+                msg.step_id,
+                forward_mode,
+                source_segments,
+            )
+
+    def _run_direct_megamoe_graph_step(
+        self,
+        wire_capacities: tuple[int, ...],
+        _compute_capacities: tuple[int, ...],
+    ) -> None:
+        self._run_direct_megamoe_step(wire_capacities)
+
+    def _run_direct_megamoe_step(
+        self,
+        wire_capacities: tuple[int, ...],
+    ) -> None:
+        set_is_extend_in_batch(False)
+        assert self._direct_megamoe is not None
+        self._direct_megamoe.run_eg(wire_capacities)
+
+    def _run_direct_deepep_graph_step(
+        self,
+        wire_capacities: tuple[int, ...],
+        _compute_capacities: tuple[int, ...],
+    ) -> None:
+        self._run_direct_deepep_step(
+            wire_capacities,
+            do_cpu_sync=False,
+        )
+
+    def _run_direct_deepep_step(
+        self,
+        wire_capacities: tuple[int, ...],
+        *,
+        do_cpu_sync: bool,
+    ) -> None:
+        compute_num_sms = self._compute_num_sms if len(wire_capacities) > 1 else None
+        with compute_sm_budget(compute_num_sms):
+            self._run_direct_deepep_step_impl(
+                wire_capacities,
+                do_cpu_sync=do_cpu_sync,
+            )
+
+    def _run_direct_deepep_step_impl(
+        self,
+        wire_capacities: tuple[int, ...],
+        *,
+        do_cpu_sync: bool,
+    ) -> None:
+        num_children = len(wire_capacities)
+        async_with_compute_stream = num_children > 1
+        # Module loading and first-use library setup may synchronize the device.
+        # Keep warmup/eager in layer order so these operations cannot wait behind
+        # a next-layer receive whose peer is still warming the current layer.
+        prefetch_next_layer = (
+            async_with_compute_stream and torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing()
+        )
+
+        first = self._layers[0]
+        hidden_states = torch.empty(
+            (0, first.hidden_size),
+            dtype=self._dtype,
+            device=self._device,
+        )
+        topk_ids = torch.empty(
+            (0, first.top_k),
+            dtype=torch.int64,
+            device=self._device,
+        )
+        topk_weights = torch.empty(
+            (0, first.top_k),
+            dtype=torch.float32,
+            device=self._device,
+        )
+        set_is_extend_in_batch(False)
+        dispatches = [
+            self._direct_deepep_lanes[child_index].dispatch(
+                first.layer_id,
+                hidden_states,
+                topk_ids,
+                topk_weights,
+                num_max_dispatch_tokens_per_rank=wire_capacity,
+                do_cpu_sync=do_cpu_sync,
+                async_with_compute_stream=async_with_compute_stream,
+            )
+            for child_index, wire_capacity in enumerate(wire_capacities)
+        ]
+        final_combines = []
+        for layer_index in range(len(self._layers)):
+            scaling_factor = self._layers[layer_index].routed_scaling_factor
+            layer_combines = []
+            next_dispatches = []
+            for child_index, dispatch_output in enumerate(dispatches):
+                dispatch_output.wait()
+                expert_output = self._compute.run_direct_deepep(
+                    layer_index,
+                    dispatch_output,
+                )
+                layer_combines.append(
+                    self._direct_deepep_lanes[child_index].combine(
+                        expert_output,
+                        dispatch_output,
+                        routed_scaling_factor=(
+                            1.0 if scaling_factor is None else float(scaling_factor)
+                        ),
+                        async_with_compute_stream=async_with_compute_stream,
+                    )
+                )
+                if prefetch_next_layer and layer_index + 1 < len(self._layers):
+                    # Refill this lane behind its combine on the same communication
+                    # stream. Waiting for other children's compute would delay the
+                    # next request even when this lane's A-side result is ready.
+                    next_dispatches.append(
+                        self._direct_deepep_lanes[child_index].dispatch(
+                            self._layers[layer_index + 1].layer_id,
+                            hidden_states,
+                            topk_ids,
+                            topk_weights,
+                            num_max_dispatch_tokens_per_rank=wire_capacities[
+                                child_index
+                            ],
+                            do_cpu_sync=do_cpu_sync,
+                            async_with_compute_stream=async_with_compute_stream,
+                        )
+                    )
+            if layer_index + 1 == len(self._layers):
+                final_combines = layer_combines
+            elif not prefetch_next_layer:
+                next_dispatches = [
+                    self._direct_deepep_lanes[child_index].dispatch(
+                        self._layers[layer_index + 1].layer_id,
+                        hidden_states,
+                        topk_ids,
+                        topk_weights,
+                        num_max_dispatch_tokens_per_rank=wire_capacity,
+                        do_cpu_sync=do_cpu_sync,
+                        async_with_compute_stream=async_with_compute_stream,
+                    )
+                    for child_index, wire_capacity in enumerate(wire_capacities)
+                ]
+            dispatches = next_dispatches
+
+        for combine_output in final_combines:
+            combine_output.wait()
+
+    def _run_eager_step(
+        self,
+        step_id: int,
+        forward_mode: ForwardMode,
+        source_segments: tuple[_SourceSegment, ...],
+    ) -> None:
+        wire_capacity = sum(segment.capacity for segment in source_segments)
+        fixed_shape = is_afd_fixed_shape_mode(forward_mode)
+        allow_compute_graph = (
+            fixed_shape and not self._scattered and self._decode_step_graph is None
+        )
+
+        for layer_index, layer in enumerate(self._layers):
+            work = None
+            if fixed_shape and wire_capacity > 0:
+                work = self._decode_pool.acquire(
+                    slot_id=0,
+                    layer_id=layer.layer_id,
+                    generation=afd_work_generation(step_id, layer_index),
+                    capacity=wire_capacity,
+                    input_tokens=wire_capacity,
+                )
+                hidden_states = work.hidden_states
+                topk_ids = work.topk_ids
+                topk_weights = work.topk_weights
+                if work.router_logits is None:
+                    raise RuntimeError("AFD ffn slot has no router logits buffer")
+                router_logits = work.router_logits
+            else:
+                hidden_states, topk_ids, topk_weights = self._make_request_buffers(
+                    layer, wire_capacity
+                )
+                router_logits = torch.empty(
+                    (wire_capacity, layer.num_experts),
+                    dtype=torch.float32,
+                    device=self._device,
+                )
+
+            self._recv_source_inputs(
+                source_segments, hidden_states, topk_ids, topk_weights
+            )
+
+            output = self._compute.run(
+                layer_index,
+                hidden_states,
+                topk_ids,
+                topk_weights,
+                router_logits,
+                allow_graph=allow_compute_graph,
+            )
+            if work is not None and not self._scattered:
+                work.output.copy_(output)
+                output = work.output
+
+            for peer_global_rank, capacity, rows in source_segments:
+                if capacity > 0:
+                    self._comm.send_to(
+                        [output[rows].contiguous()],
+                        peer_global_rank,
+                    )
+
+            if work is not None:
+                self._decode_pool.release(work)
+
+    def _enqueue_overlap_request(
+        self,
+        work: AFDWorkHandle,
+        layer_id: int,
+        child: _PreparedDecodeChild,
+        request_stream: torch.cuda.Stream,
+    ) -> None:
+        with torch.cuda.stream(request_stream):
+            if self._decode_transport is not None:
+                self._decode_transport.launch_wait_request(slot_id=child.slot_id)
+                if len(child.source_segments) > 1:
+                    self._copy_decode_inputs(
+                        layer_id,
+                        child.source_segments,
+                        work.hidden_states,
+                        work.topk_ids,
+                        work.topk_weights,
+                        slot_id=child.slot_id,
+                    )
+            else:
+                self._recv_source_inputs(
+                    child.source_segments,
+                    work.hidden_states,
+                    work.topk_ids,
+                    work.topk_weights,
+                )
+            self._request_ready[child.slot_id].record(request_stream)
+
+    def _run_overlap_step(
+        self,
+        step_id: int,
+        children: tuple[_PreparedDecodeChild, ...],
+        child_compute_capacities: tuple[int, ...] | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        with compute_sm_budget(self._compute_num_sms):
+            self._run_overlap_step_impl(
+                step_id,
+                children,
+                child_compute_capacities,
+            )
+
+    def _run_overlap_step_impl(
+        self,
+        step_id: int,
+        children: tuple[_PreparedDecodeChild, ...],
+        child_compute_capacities: tuple[int, ...] | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        assert self._communication_stream is not None
+        assert self._response_stream is not None
+        compute_stream = torch.cuda.current_stream(self._device)
+        request_stream = self._communication_stream
+        response_stream = self._response_stream
+        request_stream.wait_stream(compute_stream)
+        if response_stream is not request_stream:
+            response_stream.wait_stream(compute_stream)
+        num_children = len(children)
+        if num_children <= 1 or num_children != self._decode_num_microbatches:
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "AFD overlap child count does not match the configured "
+                f"microbatch count: children={num_children}, "
+                f"configured={self._decode_num_microbatches}"
+            )
+        direct_integrated_inputs = tuple(
+            self._decode_transport is None
+            and len(child.source_segments) == 1
+            and child_compute_capacities is not None
+            and child.local_wire_capacity <= child_compute_capacities[child_index]
+            for child_index, child in enumerate(children)
+        )
+        slot_work: list[AFDWorkHandle] = []
+
+        first_layer = self._layers[0]
+        for child_index, child in enumerate(children):
+            work_capacity = (
+                child_compute_capacities[child_index]
+                if direct_integrated_inputs[child_index]
+                else child.staging_capacity
+            )
+            work = self._decode_pool.acquire(
+                slot_id=child.slot_id,
+                layer_id=first_layer.layer_id,
+                generation=afd_work_generation(step_id, child_index),
+                capacity=work_capacity,
+                input_tokens=child.local_wire_capacity,
+            )
+            self._enqueue_overlap_request(
+                work,
+                first_layer.layer_id,
+                child,
+                request_stream,
+            )
+            slot_work.append(work)
+
+        for layer_index, layer in enumerate(self._layers):
+            for child_index in range(num_children):
+                work_index = layer_index * num_children + child_index
+                work = slot_work[child_index]
+                child = children[child_index]
+                compute_stream.wait_event(self._request_ready[child.slot_id])
+                if child_compute_capacities is None:
+                    if work.router_logits is None:
+                        raise RuntimeError("AFD ffn slot has no router logits buffer")
+                    output = self._compute.run(
+                        layer_index,
+                        work.hidden_states[: child.local_wire_capacity],
+                        work.topk_ids[: child.local_wire_capacity],
+                        work.topk_weights[: child.local_wire_capacity],
+                        work.router_logits[: child.local_wire_capacity],
+                        allow_graph=False,
+                        defer_output_scaling=True,
+                    )
+                else:
+                    direct_input = direct_integrated_inputs[child_index]
+                    compute_capacity = child_compute_capacities[child_index]
+                    input_capacity = (
+                        compute_capacity if direct_input else child.local_wire_capacity
+                    )
+                    output = self._compute.run_integrated_layer(
+                        layer_index,
+                        work.hidden_states[:input_capacity],
+                        work.topk_ids[:input_capacity],
+                        work.topk_weights[:input_capacity],
+                        child.local_wire_capacity,
+                        compute_capacity,
+                        defer_output_scaling=True,
+                        stage_inputs=not direct_input,
+                    )
+                self._response_ready[child.slot_id].record(compute_stream)
+                # Keep allocator-owned compute output alive until response
+                # staging on the response stream has consumed it.
+                output.record_stream(response_stream)
+                with torch.cuda.stream(response_stream):
+                    response_stream.wait_event(self._response_ready[child.slot_id])
+                    if self._decode_transport is not None:
+                        for peer_global_rank, capacity, rows in child.source_segments:
+                            views = self._decode_transport.decode_views(
+                                layer.layer_id,
+                                capacity,
+                                slot_id=child.slot_id,
+                                peer_global_rank=peer_global_rank,
+                            )
+                            self._compute.stage_deferred_output(
+                                layer_index,
+                                views.output,
+                                output[rows],
+                            )
+                            self._decode_transport.put_response(
+                                layer.layer_id,
+                                capacity,
+                                slot_id=child.slot_id,
+                                peer_global_rank=peer_global_rank,
+                            )
+                    else:
+                        direct_output = (
+                            len(child.source_segments) == 1 and output.is_contiguous()
+                        )
+                        if direct_output:
+                            peer_global_rank, capacity, _ = child.source_segments[0]
+                            response_output = output[:capacity]
+                            self._compute.finalize_deferred_output_in_place(
+                                layer_index, response_output
+                            )
+                            self._comm.send_to(
+                                [response_output],
+                                peer_global_rank,
+                            )
+                        else:
+                            self._compute.stage_deferred_output(
+                                layer_index,
+                                work.output[: child.local_wire_capacity],
+                                output[: child.local_wire_capacity],
+                            )
+                            for (
+                                peer_global_rank,
+                                capacity,
+                                rows,
+                            ) in child.source_segments:
+                                self._comm.send_to(
+                                    [work.output[rows]],
+                                    peer_global_rank,
+                                )
+                self._decode_pool.release(work)
+
+                next_layer_index = layer_index + 1
+                if next_layer_index == len(self._layers):
+                    continue
+                next_layer = self._layers[next_layer_index]
+                next_work_index = work_index + num_children
+                next_work_capacity = (
+                    child_compute_capacities[child_index]
+                    if direct_integrated_inputs[child_index]
+                    else child.staging_capacity
+                )
+                next_work = self._decode_pool.acquire(
+                    slot_id=child.slot_id,
+                    layer_id=next_layer.layer_id,
+                    generation=afd_work_generation(step_id, next_work_index),
+                    capacity=next_work_capacity,
+                    input_tokens=child.local_wire_capacity,
+                )
+                self._enqueue_overlap_request(
+                    next_work,
+                    next_layer.layer_id,
+                    child,
+                    request_stream,
+                )
+                slot_work[child_index] = next_work
+
+        compute_stream.wait_stream(request_stream)
+        if response_stream is not request_stream:
+            compute_stream.wait_stream(response_stream)
+
+    def _run_nvshmem_eager_step(
+        self,
+        step_id: int,
+        source_segments: tuple[_SourceSegment, ...],
+    ) -> None:
+        assert self._decode_transport is not None
+        wire_capacity = sum(segment.capacity for segment in source_segments)
+        for layer_index, layer in enumerate(self._layers):
+            work = None
+            if wire_capacity > 0:
+                work = self._decode_pool.acquire(
+                    slot_id=0,
+                    layer_id=layer.layer_id,
+                    generation=afd_work_generation(step_id, layer_index),
+                    capacity=wire_capacity,
+                    input_tokens=wire_capacity,
+                )
+                hidden_states = work.hidden_states
+                topk_ids = work.topk_ids
+                topk_weights = work.topk_weights
+                if work.router_logits is None:
+                    raise RuntimeError("AFD ffn slot has no router logits buffer")
+                router_logits = work.router_logits
+            else:
+                hidden_states, topk_ids, topk_weights = self._make_request_buffers(
+                    layer, 0
+                )
+                router_logits = torch.empty(

+class _AFDFFNCohortSelector:
+    def __init__(self, join_timeout_us: int):
+        self._join_timeout_ns = join_timeout_us * 1_000
+        self._pending: dict[int, AFDSyncMsg] = {}
+        self._previous_members: tuple[int, ...] = ()
+        self._join_deadline_ns: int | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def has_pending(self) -> bool:
+        return bool(self._pending)
+
+    def has_pending_session(self, session_id: int) -> bool:
+        return session_id in self._pending
+
+    def add(self, session_id: int, msg: AFDSyncMsg) -> None:
+        if self.has_pending_session(session_id):
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                f"AFD ffn session {session_id} has multiple pending steps"
+            )
+        self._pending[session_id] = msg
+
+    def select(
+        self,
+        now_ns: int,
+        *,
+        can_cohort: Callable[[int, AFDSyncMsg], bool],
+        cohort_cost: Callable[[int, AFDSyncMsg], tuple[int, ...]],
+        cohort_capacity: int | None,
+    ) -> list[tuple[int, AFDSyncMsg]] | None:
+        if not self._pending:
+            return None
+
+        anchor_id = next(iter(self._pending))
+        if not can_cohort(anchor_id, self._pending[anchor_id]):
+            return self._take((anchor_id,))
+
+        compatible = [anchor_id]
+        used_capacity = cohort_cost(anchor_id, self._pending[anchor_id])
+        for session_id, msg in self._pending.items():
+            if session_id == anchor_id or not can_cohort(session_id, msg):
+                continue
+            session_cost = cohort_cost(session_id, msg)
+            if len(session_cost) != len(used_capacity):
+                continue
+            next_capacity = tuple(
+                used + added
+                for used, added in zip(
+                    used_capacity,
+                    session_cost,
+                    strict=True,
+                )
+            )
+            if cohort_capacity is not None and any(
+                cost > cohort_capacity for cost in next_capacity
+            ):
+                continue
+            compatible.append(session_id)
+            used_capacity = next_capacity
+        if len(compatible) >= 2:
+            action = self._take(tuple(compatible))
+            if self._pending:
+                self._join_deadline_ns = now_ns + self._join_timeout_ns
+            return action
+
+        if len(self._pending) > 1:
+            return self._take((anchor_id,))
+        # Preserve single-session latency when the same singleton keeps
+        # producing work; join only after the active session set changes.
+        if self._previous_members == (anchor_id,):
+            return self._take((anchor_id,))
+
+        if self._join_deadline_ns is None:
+            self._join_deadline_ns = now_ns + self._join_timeout_ns
+        if now_ns < self._join_deadline_ns:
+            return None
+        return self._take((anchor_id,))
+
+    def _take(self, session_ids: tuple[int, ...]) -> list[tuple[int, AFDSyncMsg]]:
+        action = [
+            (session_id, self._pending.pop(session_id)) for session_id in session_ids
+        ]
+        self._previous_members = session_ids
+        self._join_deadline_ns = None
+        return action
+

+def _build_ffn_session(
+    scheduler: Scheduler, handshake: AFDHandshakeResult, compute

+            # its current step is waiting for cohort selection. Leave that
+            # control in ZMQ until the pending step has been submitted.
+            if session.receiver.socket not in events or selector.has_pending_session(
+                session.session_id
+            ):
+                continue
+            msg = session.receiver.recv()
+            consumed = True
+            next_session_index = (session.session_id + 1) % num_sessions
+            if not isinstance(msg, AFDSyncMsg) or (
+                sum(msg.tokens_per_rank) == 0 or ForwardMode(msg.forward_mode).is_idle()
+            ):
+                return [(session.session_id, msg)], True
+            selector.add(session.session_id, msg)
+        return None, consumed
+
+    def drain_ready_controls() -> Optional[list[tuple[int, object]]]:
+        while True:
+            immediate, consumed = receive_controls(block=False)
+            if immediate is not None:
+                return immediate
+            if not consumed:
+                return None

+        assert is_rank0 and selector is not None

+                return immediate

+                time.monotonic_ns(),
+                can_cohort=cohort_executor.can_cohort,
+                cohort_cost=cohort_executor.cohort_cost,
+                cohort_capacity=cohort_executor.cohort_capacity,
+            )
+            if action is not None:
+                return action
+        return None
+
+    def next_action() -> list[tuple[int, object]]:

+        assert is_rank0 and selector is not None and completion_event is not None
+        while True:
+            if has_submitted_action and not at_busy_boundary:
+                completion_event.synchronize()
+                immediate = drain_ready_controls()
+                if immediate is not None:
+                    return immediate
+                if selector.has_pending:

+                continue

+                    "session_steps=%s modes=%s total_tokens=%s wire=%s "
+                    "children=%s merged_wire_capacity=%d "

+                    [session_id for session_id, _ in action],
+                    [msg.step_id for _, msg in action],
+                    [ForwardMode(msg.forward_mode).name for _, msg in action],
+                    [sum(msg.tokens_per_rank) for _, msg in action],
+                    [msg.wire_capacity for _, msg in action],
+                    [msg.child_wire_capacities for _, msg in action],
+                    sum(msg.wire_capacity for _, msg in action),
+                    [msg.communication_graph for _, msg in action],
+                    compute_graph_mode,
+                )

+        if is_rank0 and active_action:
+            completion_event.record()
+            has_submitted_action = True
+            at_busy_boundary = False
+

+        return pending

+    sizes = [pending[i].shared_input.shape[0] for i in active]
+    outputs = [None] * len(active)

+        # children and lanes whose AG may already have completed.

+def run_afd_microbatch_wavefront(

+    parent_context = get_forward_context()
+    child_contexts = [

+        for child_backend in parent_context.attn_backend.children

+    pending = [None] * len(children)

+            next_layer_id = layer_id + 1

+                zip(children, child_contexts, strict=True)
+            ):
+                _set_child_dp_buffer(child)
+                with forward_context(child_context):
+                    child_states[child_index] = finish_child_layer(
+                        layers[layer_id],
+                        child,
+                        pending[child_index],
+                        child_index,
+                    )
+                    if next_layer_id < end_layer:
+                        recorder = get_global_expert_distribution_recorder()
+                        with recorder.with_current_layer(next_layer_id):
+                            pending[child_index] = launch_child_layer(
+                                layers[next_layer_id],
+                                child,
+                                child_states[child_index],
+                                child_index,
+                            )

+            if next_layer_id < end_layer and after_launch_layer is not None:
+                pending = after_launch_layer(layers[next_layer_id], pending)
+

+        forward_batch.global_dp_buffer_len,
+        forward_batch.input_ids.shape[0],
+        forward_batch.dp_padding_mode.is_max_len(),
+        forward_batch.global_num_tokens_cpu,
+    )
+    return child_states
+
+
+def split_afd_residual_stream(
+    hidden_states: torch.Tensor, forward_batch: ForwardBatch
+) -> list[torch.Tensor]:
+    from sglang.srt.layers.layer_boundary.residual import batch as residual_batch
+    from sglang.srt.layers.layer_boundary.residual.stream import ResidualStream
+
+    stream = residual_batch.stream_of(forward_batch)
+    update = stream.pending.update if stream.pending is not None else None
+    hidden_states, residual = stream.export(hidden_states)
+    child_hidden_states = []
+    for child in forward_batch.afd_microbatch_children:
+        rows = slice(*child.tbo_parent_token_range)
+        hidden, child.residual_stream = ResidualStream.from_handoff(
+            hidden_states[rows],
+            residual[rows] if residual is not None else None,
+            update,
+        )
+        child_hidden_states.append(hidden)
+    forward_batch.residual_stream = None
+    return child_hidden_states
+
+
+def merge_afd_residual_streams(
+    child_hidden_states: list[torch.Tensor], forward_batch: ForwardBatch
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    from sglang.srt.layers.layer_boundary.residual import batch as residual_batch
+    from sglang.srt.layers.layer_boundary.residual.stream import ResidualStream
+
+    children = forward_batch.afd_microbatch_children
+    outputs = []
+    residuals = []
+    first_stream = residual_batch.stream_of(children[0])
+    update = first_stream.pending.update if first_stream.pending is not None else None
+    for hidden, child in zip(child_hidden_states, children, strict=True):
+        stream = residual_batch.stream_of(child)
+        assert (stream.pending.update if stream.pending is not None else None) is update
+        hidden, residual = stream.export(hidden)
+        outputs.append(hidden)
+        residuals.append(residual)
+        child.residual_stream = None
+    hidden_states, forward_batch.residual_stream = ResidualStream.from_handoff(
+        torch.cat(outputs),
+        torch.cat(residuals) if residuals[0] is not None else None,
+        update,
+    )
+    return hidden_states
+
+
+def model_forward_afd_microbatch(
+    *,
+    layers,
+    start_layer: int,
+    end_layer: int,
+    forward_batch: ForwardBatch,
+    hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+):
+    child_states = split_afd_residual_stream(hidden_states, forward_batch)
+
+    def launch_child_layer(layer, child, hidden, _child_index):
+        return layer.forward_afd_microbatch_launch(child.positions, hidden, child)
+
+    def finish_child_layer(layer, child, pending, _child_index):
+        return layer.forward_afd_microbatch_finish(pending, child)
+
+    child_states = run_afd_microbatch_wavefront(
+        layers=layers,
+        start_layer=start_layer,
+        end_layer=end_layer,
+        forward_batch=forward_batch,
+        child_states=child_states,
+        launch_child_layer=launch_child_layer,
+        finish_child_layer=finish_child_layer,
+    )
+    return merge_afd_residual_streams(child_states, forward_batch)
+
+
+def _set_child_dp_buffer(child: ForwardBatch) -> None:
+    set_dp_buffer_len(
+        child.global_dp_buffer_len,
+        child.tbo_padded_len,
+        child.dp_padding_mode.is_max_len(),
+        child.global_num_tokens_cpu,
+    )

+def _query_nvshmem_fabric_key(device_id: int) -> tuple[bytes, int] | None:
+    try:
+        import pynvml
+    except ModuleNotFoundError:
+        logger.debug("AFD NVSHMEM fabric query skipped: pynvml is unavailable")
+        return None
+
+    initialized = False
+    try:
+        pynvml.nvmlInit()
+        initialized = True
+        nvml_device_id = _get_nvml_device_index(device_id)
+        handle = pynvml.nvmlDeviceGetHandleByIndex(nvml_device_id)
+        fabric_info = pynvml.c_nvmlGpuFabricInfoV_t()
+        pynvml.nvmlDeviceGetGpuFabricInfoV(handle, ctypes.byref(fabric_info))
+        if (
+            fabric_info.state != pynvml.NVML_GPU_FABRIC_STATE_COMPLETED
+            or fabric_info.status != pynvml.NVML_SUCCESS
+        ):
+            return None
+        # Some bindings expose this binary UUID as c_char[], which truncates
+        # at embedded NUL bytes when read as a Python value.
+        cluster_uuid = ctypes.string_at(
+            ctypes.addressof(fabric_info) + type(fabric_info).clusterUuid.offset,
+            pynvml.NVML_GPU_FABRIC_UUID_LEN,
+        )
+        if not any(cluster_uuid):
+            return None
+        return cluster_uuid, int(fabric_info.cliqueId)
+    except (AttributeError, pynvml.NVMLError) as exc:
+        logger.debug("AFD NVSHMEM fabric query unavailable: %s", exc)
+        return None
+    finally:
+        if initialized:
+            try:
+                pynvml.nvmlShutdown()
+            except pynvml.NVMLError as exc:
+                logger.debug("AFD NVML shutdown failed: %s", exc)

+class _FakeDirectLane:

+        self.dispatch_calls = []
+        self.async_calls = []

+
+    def _result(self, hidden_states, wait_event):

+    def dispatch(self, _layer_id, hidden_states, topk_ids, topk_weights, **kwargs):
+        self.events.append(("dispatch", self.lane_id))

+        self.async_calls.append(

+class TestAFDCohortSelection(unittest.TestCase):
+    @staticmethod
+    def _msg(step_id: int, wire_capacity: int = 1) -> AFDSyncMsg:
+        return AFDSyncMsg(
+            step_id=step_id,
+            tokens_per_rank=[1],
+            forward_mode=int(ForwardMode.DECODE),
+            wire_capacity=wire_capacity,
+        )
+
+    def test_step_boundary_policy(self):
+        selector = _AFDFFNCohortSelector(join_timeout_us=10)
+
+        def can_cohort(_session_id, _msg):
+            return True
+
+        def cohort_cost(_session_id, msg):
+            return (msg.wire_capacity,)
+
+        def select(now_ns, *, capacity=None):
+            return selector.select(
+                now_ns,
+                can_cohort=can_cohort,
+                cohort_cost=cohort_cost,
+                cohort_capacity=capacity,
+            )
+
+        selector.add(0, self._msg(0))
+        self.assertTrue(selector.has_pending_session(0))
+        self.assertFalse(selector.has_pending_session(1))
+        self.assertIsNone(select(0))
+        action = select(10_000)
+        self.assertEqual([session_id for session_id, _ in action], [0])
+        self.assertFalse(selector.has_pending_session(0))
+
+        selector.add(0, self._msg(1))
+        action = select(10_001)
+        self.assertEqual([session_id for session_id, _ in action], [0])
+
+        selector.add(1, self._msg(0))
+        self.assertIsNone(select(10_002))
+        selector.add(0, self._msg(2))
+        action = select(10_003)
+        self.assertEqual([session_id for session_id, _ in action], [1, 0])
+
+        selector.add(1, self._msg(1))
+        self.assertIsNone(select(10_004))
+        self.assertIsNone(select(20_003))
+        action = select(20_004)
+        self.assertEqual([session_id for session_id, _ in action], [1])
+
+        selector.add(0, self._msg(3))
+        selector.add(1, self._msg(2))
+        selector.add(2, self._msg(0))
+        action = select(20_005)
+        self.assertEqual([session_id for session_id, _ in action], [0, 1, 2])
+
+        selector.add(0, self._msg(4, wire_capacity=2))
+        selector.add(1, self._msg(3, wire_capacity=2))
+        selector.add(2, self._msg(1, wire_capacity=1))
+        action = select(20_006, capacity=3)
+        self.assertEqual([session_id for session_id, _ in action], [0, 2])
+
+        self.assertIsNone(select(30_005, capacity=3))
+        action = select(30_006, capacity=3)
+        self.assertEqual([session_id for session_id, _ in action], [1])

[Approve preview](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/45562/checks?check_run_id=123415300642)
Have you benchmarked the colocated baseline with EP16 or higher, rather than EP8? If so, could you share how the throughput per GPU and TPOT compare with AFD under those configurations?

> Have you benchmarked the colocated baseline with EP16 or higher, rather than EP8? If so, could you share how the throughput per GPU and TPOT compare with AFD under those configurations?

Not yet. The current experiments keep expert parallelism fixed at EP8 while comparing the two execution architectures. The current results are specific to these configurations; scaling both systems while keeping per-attention-rank concurrency and AFD’s attention-to-FFN GPU ratio fixed could improve expert batching efficiency in both. The relative gains will also depend on communication overhead and changes in the compute bottlenecks. We plan to explore larger-EP deployments as part of a forthcoming paper and share those results when available.

Thanks for clarifying. Could you also benchmark a 16-GPU colocated EP16 baseline against AFD with 8 attention GPUs + 8 FFN GPUs (2A×4 + F×8)? Both deployments would use the same total of 16 GPUs. It would be useful to compare their throughput at similar TPOT under this equal-GPU-budget setup, rather than keeping EP fixed at 8.

> Thanks for clarifying. Could you also benchmark a 16-GPU colocated EP16 baseline against AFD with 8 attention GPUs + 8 FFN GPUs (2A×4 + F×8)? Both deployments would use the same total of 16 GPUs. It would be useful to compare their throughput at similar TPOT under this equal-GPU-budget setup, rather than keeping EP fixed at 8. Thanks for the suggestion. I just ran an additional EP16 experiment on SM100 with Qwen3-235B. Scaling colocate to EP16 improves per-GPU throughput and brings it on par with AFD at the same GPU budget. The larger aggregate batch gives each expert more tokens to process, which can improve GEMM efficiency—the same batching effect that AFD aims to exploit by pooling tokens from multiple attention instances. We also scaled AFD’s FFN group to EP16. This further improved per-GPU throughput. A key motivation for homogeneous AFD is to feed experts with larger batches while keeping attention-side concurrency manageable. Its potential advantage lies in independently tuning attention and FFN capacity to match their different computational characteristics. These AFD results keep the A:F GPU ratio fixed. As expert execution becomes more efficient while attention-side remains unchanged, the bottleneck can shift toward attention. The optimal A:F ratio may therefore change with deployment scale.

Thanks for running these additional experiments and sharing the results! Looking forward to more benchmark results and analysis.

One more question: for hybrid-attention models such as DeepSeek-V4, could differences in attention execution time across layers introduce additional pipeline bubbles in AFD? If the FFN workload is similar across layers while attention latency varies, I wonder whether this could leave the A or F side idle more often and reduce the effectiveness of microbatch overlap. Have you observed or profiled this effect?

One additional question: was MegaMoE also enabled for the colocated baselines, including the EP8 and newly tested EP16 configurations? Or did they use DeepEP dispatch/combine with separate expert compute kernels?

> Thanks for running these additional experiments and sharing the results! Looking forward to more benchmark results and analysis.
> 
> One more question: for hybrid-attention models such as DeepSeek-V4, could differences in attention execution time across layers introduce additional pipeline bubbles in AFD? If the FFN workload is similar across layers while attention latency varies, I wonder whether this could leave the A or F side idle more often and reduce the effectiveness of microbatch overlap. Have you observed or profiled this effect?

Yes, we have looked at this in our DeepSeek-V4-Pro profiling. The ratio-4/indexer and ratio-128 layers show different timing and dependency patterns at microbatch handoffs, so the pipeline balance does vary across layers. We also observed overlap across microbatches despite this variation.

The concern is valid: a fixed microbatch configuration cannot necessarily hide the latency variation of every layer.

Thanks for confirming. Would you be able to share the DeepSeek-V4-Pro profiling trace, or representative timeline screenshots covering both the A and F sides? It would be helpful to see the pipeline bubble/idle-time fraction across different layer types, particularly the ratio-4/indexer and ratio-128 layers, and how much attention, communication, and expert computation actually overlap across microbatches. Please also include the A:F GPU configuration, concurrency, and microbatch count used for the profile.

> One additional question: was MegaMoE also enabled for the colocated baselines, including the EP8 and newly tested EP16 configurations? Or did they use DeepEP dispatch/combine with separate expert compute kernels?

Both colocated configurations used DeepEP dispatch/combine with separate expert compute kernels. Native MegaMoE does not currently support the Qwen3 block-FP8 checkpoint on SM100 through SGLang’s integration.

The performance gains reported in the PR are relative to the stated DeepEP baselines. This PR introduces the AFD execution path and the ability to provision attention and FFN resources independently. We will continue refining the kernels and share further performance analysis across deployment configurations and execution backends.

To make the implementation easier to review, we propose upstreaming AFD through a series of smaller PRs. The design and proposed breakdown are in #45568. Feedback on the runtime interfaces, PR boundaries, and ordering would be welcome.

We will keep this PR as the complete implementation and benchmark reference while preparing the incremental PRs, and track those PRs in #45568. The existing DeepEP and DeepGEMM PRs can continue to be reviewed in parallel.

@ShangmingCai Could you take a look at this AFD implementation and advise on the preferred integration path?

This PR contains the complete implementation, with accuracy and performance results and reproduction instructions. We would be happy to proceed with reviewing it as a whole if that works for the maintainers.

To make incremental review possible, we have also outlined a breakdown in RFC #45568 and opened the first PR, #45958, covering the core framework and asymmetric parallelism. The remaining capabilities are already implemented here and can follow as smaller PRs.

Feedback on both the design and the preferred review scope would be appreciated.

We optimized the activation cache policy and moved routing weight and return metadata loads earlier in the MegaMoE M2N expert kernel to better hide memory latency in sgl-project/DeepGEMM#110.

In the tested configurations, we observed up to **3.3% higher decode throughput** and a **2.6–4.7% speedup in FP8 M2N microbenchmarks**, including communication.

The performance results currently shown in this PR were measured before this optimization.

Added support for **Qwen3.5 MOE**, including multimodal inputs and its hybrid Gated DeltaNet/full-attention architecture.We measured **2.67× decode throughput per GPU at comparable TPOT** versus the colocated EP8 baseline. Accuracy and performance results for text workloads are included in the updated PR description.
